1:<script setup lang="ts">
2:/*
3: * Orders: customer orders (what people bought from the shop) and dealer
4: * orders (what the shop ordered from distributors), one tab each.
5: */
6:import type { TableColumn } from '@nuxt/ui'
7:
8:definePageMeta({ layout: 'admin', middleware: 'admin' })
9:useSeoMeta({ title: 'Orders' })
10:
11:const { supabase, check, notifyError } = useAdmin()
12:
13:const kind = ref<OrderKind>('customer')
14:const orders = ref<Order[]>([])
15:const loading = ref(true)
16:const search = ref('')
17:const showClosed = ref(false)
18:const editorOpen = ref(false)
19:const editing = ref<Order | null>(null)
20:
21:const statusColor: Record<OrderStatus, 'neutral' | 'info' | 'warning' | 'success' | 'error' | 'primary'> = {
22:  pending: 'warning',
23:  processing: 'info',
24:  shipped: 'primary',
25:  ready: 'success',
26:  completed: 'neutral',
27:  cancelled: 'error',
28:}
29:
30:async function load() {
31:  loading.value = true
32:  try {
33:    const { data } = check(await supabase
34:      .from('orders')
35:      .select('*, order_items(*)')
36:      .eq('kind', kind.value)
37:      .order('placed_at', { ascending: false })
38:      .limit(500))
39:    orders.value = data as Order[]
40:  }
41:  catch (err) {
42:    notifyError(err, 'Couldn\'t load orders')
43:  }
44:  finally {
45:    loading.value = false
46:  }
47:}
48:watch(kind, load)
49:onMounted(load)
50:
51:const filtered = computed(() => {
52:  const q = search.value.trim().toLowerCase()
53:  return orders.value.filter(o =>
54:    (showClosed.value || !['completed', 'cancelled'].includes(o.status))
55:    && (!q || [o.reference, o.customer_name, o.customer_email, o.customer_phone, o.distributor]
56:      .some(v => v.toLowerCase().includes(q))))
57:})
58:
59:const columns = computed<TableColumn<Order>[]>(() => [
60:  { accessorKey: 'placed_at', header: 'Placed' },
61:  { accessorKey: 'reference', header: 'Order #' },
62:  kind.value === 'dealer'
63:    ? { accessorKey: 'distributor', header: 'Distributor' }
64:    : { accessorKey: 'customer_name', header: 'Customer' },
65:  { id: 'items', header: 'Items' },
66:  { accessorKey: 'total', header: 'Total' },
67:  { accessorKey: 'status', header: 'Status' },
68:])
69:
70:function edit(order: Order | null) {
71:  editing.value = order
72:  editorOpen.value = true
73:}
74:
75:const itemSummary = (o: Order) => {
76:  const lines = o.order_items ?? []
77:  if (!lines.length) return '—'
78:  const first = lines[0]!
79:  return lines.length === 1 ? `${first.quantity} × ${first.description}` : `${first.description} +${lines.length - 1} more`
80:}
81:</script>
82:
83:<template>
84:  <UDashboardPanel id="orders">
85:    <template #header>
86:      <UDashboardNavbar title="Orders">
87:        <template #leading>
88:          <UDashboardSidebarCollapse />
89:        </template>
90:        <template #right>
91:          <UButton
92:            icon="i-lucide-plus"
93:            color="primary"
94:            :label="kind === 'dealer' ? 'New dealer order' : 'New customer order'"
95:            @click="edit(null)"
96:          />
97:        </template>
98:      </UDashboardNavbar>
99:      <UDashboardToolbar>
100:        <UTabs
101:          v-model="kind"
102:          :content="false"
103:          size="sm"
104:          :items="[
105:            { label: 'Customer orders', value: 'customer', icon: 'i-lucide-shopping-bag' },
106:            { label: 'Dealer orders', value: 'dealer', icon: 'i-lucide-truck' },
107:          ]"
108:        />
109:        <template #right>
110:          <USwitch
111:            v-model="showClosed"
112:            label="Show completed"
113:            size="sm"
114:          />
115:          <UInput
116:            v-model="search"
117:            icon="i-lucide-search"
118:            placeholder="Search"
119:            class="w-48"
120:          />
121:        </template>
122:      </UDashboardToolbar>
123:    </template>
124:
125:    <template #body>
126:      <UTable
127:        :data="filtered"
128:        :columns="columns"
129:        :loading="loading"
130:        :empty="kind === 'dealer' ? 'No open dealer orders.' : 'No open customer orders.'"
131:        class="cursor-pointer"
132:        :on-select="(_e, row) => edit(row.original)"
133:      >
134:        <template #placed_at-cell="{ row }">
135:          {{ formatDateTime(row.original.placed_at, false) }}
136:        </template>
137:        <template #reference-cell="{ row }">
138:          <span class="font-medium text-highlighted">{{ row.original.reference || '—' }}</span>
139:        </template>
140:        <template #customer_name-cell="{ row }">
141:          <div class="grid">
142:            <span class="text-highlighted">{{ row.original.customer_name || '—' }}</span>
143:            <span class="text-xs text-muted">{{ row.original.customer_email || row.original.customer_phone }}</span>
144:          </div>
145:        </template>
146:        <template #items-cell="{ row }">
147:          <span class="block max-w-64 truncate">{{ itemSummary(row.original) }}</span>
148:        </template>
149:        <template #total-cell="{ row }">
150:          {{ row.original.total === null ? '—' : formatPrice(row.original.total) }}
151:        </template>
152:        <template #status-cell="{ row }">
153:          <UBadge
154:            :label="row.original.status"
155:            :color="statusColor[row.original.status]"
156:            variant="subtle"
157:            class="capitalize"
158:          />
159:        </template>
160:      </UTable>
161:
162:      <AdminOrderEditor
163:        v-model:open="editorOpen"
164:        :order="editing"
165:        :kind="kind"
166:        @saved="load"
167:        @deleted="load"
168:      />
169:    </template>
170:  </UDashboardPanel>
171:</template>

1:<script setup lang="ts">
2:/*
3: * Horizontally scrolling row of shop items.
4: * Scrolls natively (trackpad, touch, shift+wheel) with snap points; mouse users
5: * can also drag it or use the arrow buttons. A progress line tracks position.
6: * `active` stages the cards in when the containing deck section arrives.
7: */
8:import type { Product } from '~/data/products'
9:
10:defineProps<{ products: Product[], active?: boolean }>()
11:/** Scroll position 0..1, for backgrounds that move with the row. */
12:const emit = defineEmits<{ progress: [value: number] }>()
13:
14:const rail = ref<HTMLElement>()
15:const progress = ref(0) // 0..1 scroll position
16:const atStart = ref(true)
17:const atEnd = ref(false)
18:
19:function update() {
20:  const el = rail.value
21:  if (!el) return
22:  const max = el.scrollWidth - el.clientWidth
23:  progress.value = max > 0 ? el.scrollLeft / max : 0
24:  emit('progress', progress.value)
25:  atStart.value = el.scrollLeft <= 2
26:  atEnd.value = el.scrollLeft >= max - 2
27:}
28:
29:function step(direction: 1 | -1) {
30:  const el = rail.value
31:  const card = el?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.card')
32:  if (!el || !card) return
33:  const gap = Number.parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el.firstElementChild!).columnGap) || 0
34:  el.scrollBy({ left: direction * (card.offsetWidth + gap), behavior: 'smooth' })
35:}
36:
37:/* ---- Mouse drag ------------------------------------------------------------ */
38:const dragging = ref(false)
39:let dragStartX = 0
40:let dragStartScroll = 0
41:let dragMoved = false
42:
43:function onPointerDown(event: PointerEvent) {
44:  if (event.pointerType !== 'mouse' || event.button !== 0 || !rail.value) return
45:  dragStartX = event.clientX
46:  dragStartScroll = rail.value.scrollLeft
47:  dragMoved = false
48:  dragging.value = true
49:}
50:function onPointerMove(event: PointerEvent) {
51:  if (!dragging.value || !rail.value) return
52:  const dx = event.clientX - dragStartX
53:  if (Math.abs(dx) > 5) dragMoved = true
54:  rail.value.scrollLeft = dragStartScroll - dx
55:}
56:function onPointerUp() {
57:  dragging.value = false
58:}
59:// A drag must not count as a click on the card it ended on.
60:function onClickCapture(event: MouseEvent) {
61:  if (dragMoved) {
62:    event.preventDefault()
63:    event.stopPropagation()
64:    dragMoved = false
65:  }
66:}
67:
68:const formatPrice = (price: number | null) =>
69:  price === null
70:    ? 'Call for price'
71:    : new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD', maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(price)
72:
73:onMounted(() => {
74:  update()
75:  window.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove)
76:  window.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp)
77:  window.addEventListener('resize', update)
78:})
79:onBeforeUnmount(() => {
80:  window.removeEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove)
81:  window.removeEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp)
82:  window.removeEventListener('resize', update)
83:})
84:</script>

[Source raw SHA256:4d74982abc7c6306395bc43a90857845dc8604617782d61e7daa9c1360475fd7]
1:/**
2: * Dashboard roles, lowest to highest. Each role can do everything the roles
3: * below it can. Mirrors the `staff_role` enum in the database, where the same
4: * order is enforced by row-level security.
5: */
6:export const staffRoles = ['staff', 'manager', 'owner', 'admin'] as const
7:export type StaffRole = (typeof staffRoles)[number]
8:
9:export const staffRoleLabels: Record<StaffRole, string> = {
10:  staff: 'Staff',
11:  manager: 'Manager',
12:  owner: 'Owner',
13:  admin: 'Admin',
14:}
15:
16:export function isStaffRole(value: unknown): value is StaffRole {
17:  return staffRoles.includes(value as StaffRole)
18:}
19:
20:/** True when `role` is `required` or higher. */
21:export function hasRole(role: StaffRole | null | undefined, required: StaffRole) {
22:  return !!role && staffRoles.indexOf(role) >= staffRoles.indexOf(required)
23:}
24:
25:/**
26: * Roles `actor` may grant, change or remove on other people: admins manage
27: * everyone, owners everyone but admins, managers staff only, staff no one.
28: */
29:export function manageableRoles(actor: StaffRole | null | undefined): StaffRole[] {
30:  if (actor === 'admin') return [...staffRoles]
31:  if (actor === 'owner') return ['staff', 'manager', 'owner']
32:  if (actor === 'manager') return ['staff']
33:  return []
34:}

1:/**
2: * Server-side role checks for the dashboard API routes. Every route under
3: * server/api/admin starts with `requireStaff`, which also hands back a
4: * service-role client: it bypasses row-level security, so the route itself
5: * is responsible for checking what the caller may do.
6: */
7:import type { H3Event } from 'h3'
8:import { serverSupabaseServiceRole, serverSupabaseUser } from '#supabase/server'
9:import type { Database } from '../../shared/types/database.types'
10:
11:/** Service-role Supabase client, typed from shared/types/database.types.ts. */
12:export type AdminClient = ReturnType<typeof serverSupabaseServiceRole<Database>>
13:
14:export async function requireStaff(event: H3Event, required: StaffRole) {
15:  const claims = await serverSupabaseUser(event).catch(() => null)
16:  const userId = claims?.sub
17:  if (!userId) throw createError({ statusCode: 401, statusMessage: 'Sign in required' })
18:
19:  const admin = serverSupabaseServiceRole(event)
20:  const { data, error } = await admin
21:    .from('staff_members')
22:    .select('email, role')
23:    .eq('user_id', userId)
24:    .maybeSingle()
25:  if (error) throw createError({ statusCode: 500, statusMessage: error.message })
26:  if (!data || !hasRole(data.role, required)) {
27:    throw createError({ statusCode: 403, statusMessage: 'Your role does not allow this' })
28:  }
29:  return { userId, email: data.email, role: data.role, admin }
30:}
31:
32:/** Turns a Supabase error into an HTTP error with its message. */
33:export function failOn(error: { message: string } | null, statusCode = 500) {
34:  if (error) throw createError({ statusCode, statusMessage: error.message })
35:}

[Source raw SHA256:b67a6f68bab7e4e288373ff320d10c60582e992a6c6b94ffa34d951e4514d2a0]
1:/**
2: * Shared entry point for anything that adds events automatically: AI
3: * discovery today; calendar feeds, distributor or auction-site scrapers, or a
4: * future Python worker later. Each source names itself (`source`) and gives
5: * every event a stable `externalId`; rows that already exist for that pair
6: * are skipped, so re-running an import never duplicates events or overwrites
7: * what staff edited. Imported events arrive as 'suggested' for staff to
8: * approve, unless the source is trusted enough to schedule directly.
9: */
10:
11:/** Stable hex id for text, e.g. to derive an externalId from an event's title and day. */
12:export async function stableId(text: string) {
13:  const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-1', new TextEncoder().encode(text))
14:  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest), b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')
15:}
16:
17:export interface ImportedEvent {
18:  externalId: string
19:  title: string
20:  startsAt: string
21:  endsAt?: string | null
22:  allDay?: boolean
23:  location?: string
24:  description?: string
25:  url?: string | null
26:}
27:
28:export async function importEvents(
29:  admin: AdminClient,
30:  source: string,
31:  events: ImportedEvent[],
32:  status: EventStatus = 'suggested',
33:) {
34:  if (!events.length) return { added: 0 }
35:  const rows = events.map(e => ({
36:    source,
37:    external_id: e.externalId,
38:    title: e.title,
39:    starts_at: e.startsAt,
40:    ends_at: e.endsAt ?? null,
41:    all_day: e.allDay ?? false,
42:    location: e.location ?? '',
43:    description: e.description ?? '',
44:    source_url: e.url ?? null,
45:    status,
46:  }))
47:  const { data, error } = await admin
48:    .from('events')
49:    .upsert(rows, { onConflict: 'source,external_id', ignoreDuplicates: true })
50:    .select('id')
51:  failOn(error)
52:  return { added: data?.length ?? 0 }
53:}

20:  const { ai, secrets } = await readValidatedBody(event, body.parse)
21:  if (Object.keys(secrets ?? {}).length && !hasRole(role, 'owner')) {
22:    throw createError({ statusCode: 403, statusMessage: 'Only an owner can change API keys and the webhook URL.' })

27:      key: 'ai',
28:      value: ai,

31:    failOn(error)
32:  }
33:  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(secrets ?? {})) {

35:  }

38:    ai: await getAiSettings(admin),
39:    secrets: await getSecretStatuses(admin),
40:    canStoreSecrets: canStoreSecrets(event),
41:  }
42:})

1:/**
2: * Dashboard settings on the server: non-secret values in app_settings, and
3: * API keys in app_secrets encrypted with AES-256-GCM (Web Crypto, so it runs
4: * on any server runtime). The encryption key comes from
5: * NUXT_SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY and never reaches the database, so a database
6: * leak alone does not expose the keys. Decrypted values stay on the server;
7: * the browser only ever sees whether a key is set and its last 4.
8: */
9:import type { H3Event } from 'h3'
10:
11:export const defaultAiSettings: AiSettings = {
12:  defaultProvider: 'local',
13:  localUrl: 'http://localhost:11434/v1',
14:  models: {
15:    local: 'llama3.1',
16:    openai: 'gpt-4.1-mini',
17:    anthropic: 'claude-sonnet-4-5',
18:    gemini: 'gemini-2.5-flash',
19:  },
20:}
21:
22:export async function getAiSettings(admin: AdminClient): Promise<AiSettings> {
23:  const { data, error } = await admin.from('app_settings').select('value').eq('key', 'ai').maybeSingle()
24:  failOn(error)
25:  const saved = (data?.value ?? {}) as Partial<AiSettings>
26:  return {
27:    ...defaultAiSettings,
28:    ...saved,
29:    models: { ...defaultAiSettings.models, ...saved.models },
30:  }
31:}
32:
33:/* ---- Encryption ---------------------------------------------------------- */
34:function passphrase(event: H3Event) {
35:  return useRuntimeConfig(event).settingsEncryptionKey || ''
36:}
37:
38:export function canStoreSecrets(event: H3Event) {
39:  return passphrase(event) !== ''
40:}
41:
42:async function requireKey(event: H3Event) {
43:  const raw = passphrase(event)
44:  if (!raw) {
45:    throw createError({ statusCode: 500, statusMessage: 'NUXT_SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set on the server' })
46:  }
47:  // Any string works as a passphrase; hashing gives the 32 bytes AES-256 needs.
48:  const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(raw))
49:  return crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', digest, 'AES-GCM', false, ['encrypt', 'decrypt'])
50:}
51:
52:const toBase64 = (bytes: Uint8Array) => btoa(Array.from(bytes, b => String.fromCharCode(b)).join(''))
53:const fromBase64 = (text: string) => Uint8Array.from(atob(text), c => c.charCodeAt(0))
54:
55:/** "v1:<iv>:<ciphertext with auth tag>", both base64. */
56:async function encrypt(key: CryptoKey, plain: string) {
57:  const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12))
58:  const data = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv }, key, new TextEncoder().encode(plain))
59:  return `v1:${toBase64(iv)}:${toBase64(new Uint8Array(data))}`
60:}
61:
62:async function decrypt(key: CryptoKey, stored: string) {
63:  const [version, iv, data] = stored.split(':')
64:  if (version !== 'v1' || !iv || !data) throw new Error('Unrecognized secret format')
65:  const plain = await crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv: fromBase64(iv) }, key, fromBase64(data))
66:  return new TextDecoder().decode(plain)
67:}
68:
69:/* ---- Secret storage ------------------------------------------------------ */
70:export async function getSecretStatuses(admin: AdminClient) {
71:  const { data, error } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('name, last4, updated_at')
72:  failOn(error)
73:  return Object.fromEntries(secretNames.map((name) => {
74:    const row = data?.find(r => r.name === name)
75:    return [name, { set: !!row, last4: row?.last4 ?? '', updated_at: row?.updated_at ?? null }]
76:  })) as Record<SecretName, SecretStatus>
77:}
78:
79:/** Saves a secret, or deletes it when `value` is null or empty. */
80:export async function writeSecret(event: H3Event, admin: AdminClient, name: SecretName, value: string | null, userId: string) {
81:  const trimmed = value?.trim()
82:  if (!trimmed) {
83:    failOn((await admin.from('app_secrets').delete().eq('name', name)).error)
84:    return
85:  }
86:  const { error } = await admin.from('app_secrets').upsert({
87:    name,
88:    ciphertext: await encrypt(await requireKey(event), trimmed),
89:    last4: trimmed.slice(-4),
90:    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
91:    updated_by: userId,
92:  })
93:  failOn(error)
94:}
95:
96:/** The decrypted secret, or '' when it isn't set. */
97:export async function readSecret(event: H3Event, admin: AdminClient, name: SecretName) {
98:  const { data, error } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('ciphertext').eq('name', name).maybeSingle()
99:  failOn(error)
100:  if (!data) return ''
101:  const key = await requireKey(event)
102:  try {
103:    return await decrypt(key, data.ciphertext)
104:  }
105:  catch {
106:    throw createError({
107:      statusCode: 500,
108:      statusMessage: `Could not decrypt ${name}. The encryption key changed; save the key again in Settings.`,
109:    })
110:  }
111:}

24:  slug: z.string().regex(/^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$/, 'Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes'),
25:  price: z.string().refine(v => v.trim() === '' || (Number.isFinite(Number(v)) && Number(v) >= 0), 'Enter a price, or leave empty for "Call for price"'),
26:  quantity: z.number().int().min(0),
27:})
28:
29:function blank() {
30:  return {
31:    name: '',
32:    slug: '',
33:    category: '',
34:    description: '',
35:    price: '',
36:    sku: '',
37:    upc: '',
38:    quantity: 0,
39:    status: 'draft' as ProductStatus,
40:    featured: false,
41:    sort_order: 0,
42:  }
43:}
44:const state = reactive(blank())
45:const images = ref<ProductImage[]>([])
46:const slugTouched = ref(false)
47:const saving = ref(false)
48:const uploading = ref(false)
49:const id = ref<string | null>(null)
50:
51:watch(open, (isOpen) => {
52:  if (!isOpen) return
53:  const p = props.product
54:  Object.assign(state, blank(), p
55:    ? { ...p, price: p.price === null ? '' : String(p.price), sku: p.sku ?? '', upc: p.upc ?? '' }
56:    : {})
57:  id.value = p?.id ?? null
58:  images.value = [...(p?.product_images ?? [])].sort((a, b) => a.sort_order - b.sort_order)
59:  slugTouched.value = !!p
60:}, { immediate: true })
61:
62:watch(() => state.name, (name) => {
63:  if (!slugTouched.value) state.slug = slugify(name)
64:})
65:
66:const select = '*, product_images(*)'
67:
68:async function save() {
69:  saving.value = true
70:  try {
71:    const payload = {
72:      name: state.name.trim(),
73:      slug: state.slug,
74:      category: state.category.trim(),
75:      description: state.description,
76:      price: state.price.trim() === '' ? null : Number(state.price),
77:      sku: state.sku.trim() || null,
78:      upc: state.upc.trim() || null,
79:      quantity: state.quantity,
80:      status: state.status,
81:      featured: state.featured,
82:      sort_order: state.sort_order,
83:    }
84:    const query = id.value
85:      ? supabase.from('products').update(payload).eq('id', id.value)
86:      : supabase.from('products').insert(payload)
87:    const { data } = check(await query.select(select).single())
88:    const saved = data as ProductRow
89:    id.value = saved.id
90:    slugTouched.value = true
91:    emit('saved', saved)
92:    notify(props.product ? 'Item saved' : 'Item created', props.product ? undefined : 'You can add photos now.')
93:  }
94:  catch (err) {
95:    const message = (err as { code?: string }).code === '23505' ? 'Another item already uses this URL name (slug).' : err
96:    notifyError(message)
97:  }
98:  finally {
99:    saving.value = false
100:  }
101:}
102:
103:async function refreshImages() {
104:  const { data } = check(await supabase.from('product_images').select('*').eq('product_id', id.value!).order('sort_order'))
105:  images.value = data as ProductImage[]
106:  // Let the list update its cover photo without a full reload.
107:  const { data: product } = check(await supabase.from('products').select(select).eq('id', id.value!).single())
108:  emit('saved', product as ProductRow)
109:}
110:
111:async function addPhotos(files: File[]) {
112:  if (!id.value) return
113:  uploading.value = true
114:  try {
115:    let order = images.value.reduce((max, img) => Math.max(max, img.sort_order + 1), 0)
116:    for (const file of files) {
117:      const path = await uploadPhoto(`products/${id.value}`, file)
118:      check(await supabase.from('product_images').insert({
119:        product_id: id.value,
120:        path,
121:        alt: state.name,
122:        sort_order: order++,
123:      }))
124:    }
125:    await refreshImages()
126:  }
127:  catch (err) {
128:    notifyError(err, 'Upload failed')
129:  }
130:  finally {
131:    uploading.value = false
132:  }
133:}
134:
135:async function movePhoto(index: number, direction: -1 | 1) {
136:  const list = [...images.value]
137:  const target = index + direction
138:  if (target < 0 || target >= list.length) return
139:  ;[list[index], list[target]] = [list[target]!, list[index]!]
140:  try {
141:    await Promise.all(list.map((img, i) =>
142:      supabase.from('product_images').update({ sort_order: i }).eq('id', img.id).then(check)))
143:    await refreshImages()
144:  }
145:  catch (err) {
146:    notifyError(err)
147:  }
148:}
149:
150:async function deletePhoto(image: ProductImage) {
151:  try {
152:    check(await supabase.from('product_images').delete().eq('id', image.id))
153:    await removePhotos([image.path])
154:    await refreshImages()
155:  }
156:  catch (err) {
157:    notifyError(err, 'Couldn\'t delete the photo')
158:  }
159:}
160:
161:async function deleteProduct() {
162:  if (!id.value || !window.confirm(`Delete "${state.name}" and its photos? This can't be undone.`)) return
163:  try {

165:    check(await supabase.from('products').delete().eq('id', id.value))
166:    await removePhotos(paths)
167:    emit('deleted', id.value)
168:    notify('Item deleted')
169:    open.value = false
170:  }
171:  catch (err) {
172:    notifyError(err, 'Couldn\'t delete')
173:  }
174:}

[Source raw SHA256:900299ce47e629afdf123627a87e789b898f7cbe61e65eaf4d1431855eb48048]
1:/**
2: * Small helpers shared by the dashboard pages: toasts for saves and errors,
3: * and the site-media storage bucket (public photo URLs and uploads).
4: */
5:export function useAdmin() {
6:  const toast = useToast()
7:  const supabase = useSupabaseClient()
8:  const bucket = () => supabase.storage.from('site-media')
9:
10:  /** Message from a Supabase error, a server route error, or anything thrown. */
11:  function errorMessage(err: unknown): string {
12:    if (typeof err === 'string') return err
13:    const e = err as { data?: { statusMessage?: string, message?: string }, statusMessage?: string, message?: string }
14:    return e?.data?.statusMessage || e?.data?.message || e?.statusMessage || e?.message || 'Something went wrong'
15:  }
16:
17:  function notifyError(err: unknown, title = 'Couldn\'t save') {
18:    toast.add({ title, description: errorMessage(err), color: 'error', icon: 'i-lucide-circle-alert' })
19:  }
20:
21:  function notify(title: string, description?: string) {
22:    toast.add({ title, description, color: 'success', icon: 'i-lucide-check' })
23:  }
24:
25:  /** Throws Supabase's error so callers can use one try/catch; narrows the result to success. */
26:  function check<T extends { error: unknown }>(result: T): Extract<T, { error: null }> {
27:    if (result.error) throw result.error
28:    return result as Extract<T, { error: null }>
29:  }
30:
31:  function mediaUrl(path: string | null | undefined) {
32:    return path ? bucket().getPublicUrl(path).data.publicUrl : ''
33:  }
34:
35:  /** Uploads a photo under `folder` (products/<id> or hero) and returns its storage path. */
36:  async function uploadPhoto(folder: string, file: File) {
37:    const ext = file.name.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '') || 'jpg'
38:    const path = `${folder}/${crypto.randomUUID()}.${ext}`
39:    check(await bucket().upload(path, file, { contentType: file.type, cacheControl: '31536000' }))
40:    return path
41:  }
42:
43:  async function removePhotos(paths: string[]) {
44:    if (paths.length) check(await bucket().remove(paths))
45:  }
46:
47:  return { supabase, notify, notifyError, errorMessage, check, mediaUrl, uploadPhoto, removePhotos }
48:}
49:
50:/** Formats a price, or "Call for price" when there is none. */
51:export function formatPrice(value: number | null | undefined, digits = 2) {
52:  if (value === null || value === undefined) return 'Call for price'
53:  return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD', maximumFractionDigits: digits }).format(value)
54:}
55:
56:/** "Oct 24, 2026, 3:00 PM" in the browser's time zone. */
57:export function formatDateTime(value: string | null | undefined, withTime = true) {
58:  if (!value) return ''
59:  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', withTime
60:    ? { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }
61:    : { dateStyle: 'medium' }).format(new Date(value))
62:}
63:
64:/** ISO timestamp → value for <input type="datetime-local"> (local time). */
65:export function toLocalInput(value: string | null | undefined) {
66:  if (!value) return ''
67:  const d = new Date(value)
68:  const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0')
69:  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}T${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`
70:}
71:
72:/** <input type="datetime-local"> value → ISO timestamp, or null when empty. */
73:export function fromLocalInput(value: string | null | undefined) {
74:  return value ? new Date(value).toISOString() : null
75:}
76:
77:/** "Stippled P365 frame!" → "stippled-p365-frame" */
78:export function slugify(text: string) {
79:  return text.toLowerCase().normalize('NFKD').replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
80:}

1:/**
2: * The signed-in user's dashboard role (null for customers and signed-out
3: * visitors). Loaded once per user and shared app-wide; row-level security
4: * enforces the same role in the database, so this only decides what to show.
5: */
6:export function useStaff() {
7:  const supabase = useSupabaseClient()
8:  const user = useSupabaseUser()
9:  const state = useState<{ userId: string | null, role: StaffRole | null }>('staff-role', () => ({ userId: null, role: null }))
10:
11:  const userId = computed(() => (user.value?.sub as string | undefined) ?? null)
12:  const role = computed(() => (state.value.userId && state.value.userId === userId.value ? state.value.role : null))
13:
14:  async function load() {
15:    if (!userId.value) return null
16:    if (state.value.userId === userId.value) return state.value.role
17:    const { data } = await supabase.from('staff_members').select('role').eq('user_id', userId.value).maybeSingle()
18:    state.value = { userId: userId.value, role: isStaffRole(data?.role) ? data.role : null }
19:    return state.value.role
20:  }
21:
22:  return {
23:    userId,
24:    email: computed(() => (user.value?.email as string | undefined) ?? ''),
25:    role,
26:    load,
27:    can: (required: StaffRole) => hasRole(role.value, required),
28:  }
29:}

[Source raw SHA256:f4789dfc0528a8e675f0f1de1340a7146660ac8ebd189808eda8785d95f9b803]
1:/**
2: * Home page content managed from the dashboard: the hero stack (Site) and
3: * featured shop items (Inventory). Fetched during SSR, so the page is
4: * complete for visitors and search engines.
5: *
6: * Until the dashboard has entries, or if the database can't be reached, the
7: * built-in placeholders in app/data are shown instead, so the page never
8: * renders empty.
9: */
10:import { showcase as placeholderPhotos } from '~/data/showcase'
11:import type { ShowcasePhoto } from '~/data/showcase'
12:import { products as placeholderProducts } from '~/data/products'
13:import type { Product } from '~/data/products'
14:
15:interface HeroRow { label: string, alt: string, path: string | null }
16:interface FeaturedRow {
17:  slug: string
18:  name: string
19:  category: string
20:  price: number | null
21:  product_images: { path: string }[]
22:}
23:
24:export async function useHomeContent() {
25:  const supabase = useSupabaseClient()
26:  const publicUrl = (path: string) => supabase.storage.from('site-media').getPublicUrl(path).data.publicUrl
27:
28:  const { data } = await useAsyncData('home-content', async () => {
29:    const [hero, featured] = await Promise.all([
30:      supabase.from('hero_photos').select('label, alt, path').eq('active', true).order('sort_order'),
31:      supabase
32:        .from('products')
33:        .select('slug, name, category, price, product_images(path)')
34:        .eq('status', 'active')
35:        .eq('featured', true)
36:        .order('sort_order')
37:        .order('sort_order', { referencedTable: 'product_images' })
38:        .limit(1, { referencedTable: 'product_images' })
39:        .limit(24),
40:    ])
41:    if (hero.error) console.error('[home] hero photos:', hero.error.message)
42:    if (featured.error) console.error('[home] featured products:', featured.error.message)
43:
44:    const photos: ShowcasePhoto[] = ((hero.data ?? []) as HeroRow[]).map(row => ({
45:      label: row.label,
46:      alt: row.alt || row.label,
47:      src: row.path ? publicUrl(row.path) : undefined,
48:    }))
49:    const products: Product[] = ((featured.data ?? []) as FeaturedRow[]).map(row => ({
50:      slug: row.slug,
51:      name: row.name,
52:      category: row.category,
53:      price: row.price,
54:      image: row.product_images[0] ? publicUrl(row.product_images[0].path) : undefined,
55:    }))
56:    return { photos, products }
57:  })
58:
59:  return {
60:    photos: computed(() => data.value?.photos.length ? data.value.photos : placeholderPhotos),
61:    products: computed(() => data.value?.products.length ? data.value.products : placeholderProducts),
62:  }
63:}

1:<script setup lang="ts">
2:/*
3: * Create or edit an order. Customer orders record who bought what; dealer
4: * orders record what the shop ordered from a distributor. Line items can
5: * point at an inventory item or just describe what was ordered. Online
6: * checkout will create customer orders here automatically once it exists.
7: */
8:const props = defineProps<{ order: Order | null, kind: OrderKind }>()
9:const open = defineModel<boolean>('open', { default: false })
10:const emit = defineEmits<{ saved: [order: Order], deleted: [id: string] }>()
11:
12:const { supabase, check, notify, notifyError } = useAdmin()
13:
14:const statusItems = orderStatuses.map(value => ({ label: value[0]!.toUpperCase() + value.slice(1), value }))
15:const distributors = ['Lipsey\'s', 'Sports South']
16:
17:interface ItemDraft { product_id: string | null, description: string, quantity: number, unit_price: string }
18:
19:const state = reactive({
20:  reference: '',
21:  status: 'pending' as OrderStatus,
22:  customer_name: '',
23:  customer_email: '',
24:  customer_phone: '',
25:  distributor: '',
26:  total: '',
27:  notes: '',
28:  placed_at: '',
29:})
30:const items = ref<ItemDraft[]>([])
31:const id = ref<string | null>(null)
32:const saving = ref(false)
33:const kind = computed(() => props.order?.kind ?? props.kind)
34:
35:const productOptions = ref<{ label: string, value: string, price: number | null }[]>([])
36:async function loadProducts() {
37:  const { data } = await supabase.from('products').select('id, name, price').neq('status', 'archived').order('name')
38:  productOptions.value = (data ?? []).map(p => ({ label: p.name, value: p.id, price: p.price }))
39:}
40:
41:watch(open, (isOpen) => {
42:  if (!isOpen) return
43:  const o = props.order
44:  id.value = o?.id ?? null
45:  Object.assign(state, {
46:    reference: o?.reference ?? '',
47:    status: o?.status ?? 'pending',
48:    customer_name: o?.customer_name ?? '',
49:    customer_email: o?.customer_email ?? '',
50:    customer_phone: o?.customer_phone ?? '',
51:    distributor: o?.distributor ?? '',
52:    total: o?.total === null || o?.total === undefined ? '' : String(o.total),
53:    notes: o?.notes ?? '',
54:    placed_at: toLocalInput(o?.placed_at ?? new Date().toISOString()),
55:  })
56:  items.value = (o?.order_items ?? []).map(i => ({
57:    product_id: i.product_id,
58:    description: i.description,
59:    quantity: i.quantity,
60:    unit_price: i.unit_price === null ? '' : String(i.unit_price),
61:  }))
62:  if (!productOptions.value.length) loadProducts()
63:}, { immediate: true })
64:
65:function addItem() {
66:  items.value.push({ product_id: null, description: '', quantity: 1, unit_price: '' })
67:}
68:
69:function pickProduct(item: ItemDraft, productId: string | null) {
70:  item.product_id = productId
71:  const product = productOptions.value.find(p => p.value === productId)
72:  if (!product) return
73:  if (!item.description) item.description = product.label
74:  if (!item.unit_price && product.price !== null) item.unit_price = String(product.price)
75:}
76:
77:const itemsTotal = computed(() => {
78:  const priced = items.value.filter(i => i.unit_price.trim() !== '' && Number.isFinite(Number(i.unit_price)))
79:  return priced.length ? priced.reduce((sum, i) => sum + Number(i.unit_price) * i.quantity, 0) : null
80:})
81:
82:const money = (v: string) => (v.trim() === '' ? null : Number(v))
83:
84:async function save() {
85:  if (items.value.some(i => !i.description.trim())) return notifyError('Every line needs a description')
86:  if ([state.total, ...items.value.map(i => i.unit_price)].some(v => v.trim() !== '' && !(Number(v) >= 0))) {
87:    return notifyError('Prices must be numbers of 0 or more')
88:  }
89:  saving.value = true
90:  try {
91:    const payload = {
92:      kind: kind.value,
93:      reference: state.reference.trim(),
94:      status: state.status,
95:      customer_name: state.customer_name.trim(),
96:      customer_email: state.customer_email.trim(),
97:      customer_phone: state.customer_phone.trim(),
98:      distributor: state.distributor.trim(),
99:      total: money(state.total),

116:        description: i.description.trim(),

121:    const { data: saved } = check(await supabase.from('orders').select('*, order_items(*)').eq('id', id.value!).single())

Returns one object per data row,\\n * keyed by the header row; blank lines are skipped.\\n */\\nexport function parseCsv(text: string): Record<string, string>[] {\\n  const rows: string[][] = []\\n  let row: string[] = []\\n  let field = ''\\n  let quoted = false\\n  let i = text.charCodeAt(0) === 0xFEFF ? 1 : 0\\n\\n  for (; i < text.length; i++) {\\n    const c = text[i]\\n    if (quoted) {\\n      if (c === '\\\"') {\\n        if (text[i + 1] === '\\\"') {\\n          field += '\\\"'\\n          i++\\n        }\\n        else quoted = false\\n      }\\n      else field += c\\n    }\\n    else if (c === '\\\"') quoted = true\\n    else if (c === ',') {\\n      row.push(field)\\n      field = ''\\n    }\\n    else if (c === '\\\\n' || c === '\\\\r') {\\n      if (c === '\\\\r' && text[i + 1] === '\\\\n') i++\\n      row.push(field)\\n      rows.push(row)\\n      row = []\\n      field = ''\\n    }\\n    else field += c\\n  }\\n  if (quoted) throw new Error('The file ends inside a quoted field')\\n  if (field !== '' || row.length) {\\n    row.push(field)\\n    rows.push(row)\\n  }\\n\\n  const nonEmpty = rows.filter(r => r.length > 1 || r[0] !== '')\\n  const [header, ...data] = nonEmpty\\n  if (!header) return []\\n  const keys = header.map(h => h.trim())\\n  return data.map(values => Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key, k) => [key, values[k] ?? ''])))\\n}\\n\",\"path\":\"server/utils/csv.ts\"}",

Downloaded from the DOJ\\n * site into ca_handgun_roster and reused for a week; if the DOJ site can't\\n * be reached, the last saved copy is used.\\n */\\nconst rosterUrl = 'https://oag.ca.gov/firearms/certified-handguns/search'\\nconst maxAgeMs = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000\\n\\nexport interface RosterEntry {\\n  id: string\\n  make: string\\n  model: string\\n  gun_type: string\\n  caliber: string\\n  barrel_length: string\\n  expires_on: string | null\\n}\\n\\nconst decode = (html: string) => html\\n  .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '')\\n  .replace(/&#(\\\\d+);/g, (_, n) => String.fromCharCode(Number(n)))\\n  .replace(/&quot;/g, '\\\"')\\n  .replace(/&#039;|&apos;/g, '\\\\'')\\n  .replace(/&lt;/g, '<')\\n  .replace(/&gt;/g, '>')\\n  .replace(/&nbsp;/g, ' ')\\n  .replace(/&amp;/g, '&')\\n  .replace(/\\\\s+/g, ' ')\\n  .trim()\\n\\n/** Rows of the DOJ search page (one table, every certified model). */\\nexport function parseRosterPage(html: string): RosterEntry[] {\\n  const body = html.slice(html.indexOf('<tbody'), html.indexOf('</tbody>'))\\n  const entries: RosterEntry[] = []\\n  for (const [, row] of body.matchAll(/<tr[^>]*>([\\\\s\\\\S]*?)<\\\\/tr>/g)) {\\n    const cells = [...row!.matchAll(/<td[^>]*>([\\\\s\\\\S]*?)<\\\\/td>/g)].map(m => m[1]!)\\n    if (cells.length < 6) continue\\n    const id = cells[1]!.match(/href=\\\"\\\\/firearms\\\\/handgun\\\\/([^\\\"]+)\\\"/)?.[1]\\n    if (!id) continue\\n    entries.push({\\n      id,\\n      make: decode(cells[0]!),\\n      model: decode(cells[1]!),\\n      gun_type: decode(cells[2]!),\\n      barrel_length: decode(cells[3]!),\\n      caliber: decode(cells[4]!),\\n      expires_on: cells[5]!.match(/content=\\\"(\\\\d{4}-\\\\d{2}-\\\\d{2})/)?.[1] ?? null,\\n    })\\n  }\\n  return entries\\n}\\n\\nasync function download(admin: AdminClient) {\\n  const html = await $fetch<string>(rosterUrl, { responseType: 'text', timeout: 60_000 })\\n  const entries = parseRosterPage(html)\\n  // The roster has about a thousand models; far fewer means the page changed.\\n  if (entries.length < 200) throw new Error(`the DOJ page listed only ${entries.length} handguns`)\\n  const fetchedAt = new Date().toISOString()\\n  const unique = [...new Map(entries.map(e => [e.id, { ...e, fetched_at: fetchedAt }])).values()]\\n  failOn((await admin.from('ca_handgun_roster').upsert(unique)).error)\\n  failOn((await admin.from('ca_handgun_roster').delete().lt('fetched_at', fetchedAt)).error)\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * The saved roster, refreshed first when it is over a week old. `fetchedAt`\\n * is null when there is no roster at all (never downloaded and the DOJ site\\n * is unreachable); handguns then stay in review.\\n */\\nexport async function loadRoster(admin: AdminClient) {\\n  const latest = await admin.from('ca_handgun_roster').select('fetched_at').order('fetched_at', { ascending: false }).limit(1).maybeSingle()\\n  failOn(latest.error)\\n  let warning: string | null = null\\n  if (!latest.data || Date.now() - new Date(latest.data.fetched_at).getTime() > maxAgeMs) {\\n    try {\\n      await download(admin)\\n    }\\n    catch (err) {\\n      warning = `Couldn't update the CA handgun roster (${(err as Error).message}).`\\n      console.error('[roster]', warning)\\n    }\\n  }\\n  const entries: (RosterEntry & { fetched_at: string })[] = []\\n  for (let from = 0; ; from += 1000) {\\n    const { data, error } = await admin.from('ca_handgun_roster').select('*').order('id').range(from, from + 999)\\n    failOn(error)\\n    entries.push(...data)\\n    if (data.length < 1000) break\\n  }\\n  return { entries, fetchedAt: entries[0]?.fetched_at ?? null, warning }\\n}\\n\",\"path\":\"server/utils/caRoster.ts\"}",

See server/utils/catalogImport.ts for what an import changes.\\n */\\nimport * as z from 'zod'\\n\\nconst options = z.object({\\n  source: z.enum(Object.keys(catalogSources) as [CatalogSource]),\\n  markupPercent: z.coerce.number().min(0).max(500),\\n  complete: z.enum(['true', 'false']).transform(v => v === 'true'),\\n  newStatus: z.enum(['draft', 'active']),\\n})\\n\\nconst maxBytes = 50 * 1024 * 1024\\n\\nexport default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {\\n  const { admin, userId } = await requireStaff(event, 'manager')\\n  const parts = await readMultipartFormData(event)\\n  const file = parts?.find(p => p.name === 'file' && p.filename)\\n  if (!file) throw createError({ statusCode: 400, statusMessage: 'Choose a CSV file to import.' })\\n  if (file.data.length > maxBytes) throw createError({ statusCode: 413, statusMessage: 'The file is over 50 MB.' })\\n\\n  const fields = Object.fromEntries((parts ?? 149:const batchSize = 500

151:export interface ImportOptions {

161:export async function importCatalog(admin: AdminClient, parsed: { items: CatalogItem[], skipped: number }, options: ImportOptions) {
162:  const { items, skipped } = parsed
163:  const { source, markupPercent, complete, newStatus, userId } = options
164:  // Distributors occasionally list an item twice; the last row wins.
165:  const unique = [...new Map(items.map(i => [i.externalId, i])).values()]
166:

168:  const rosterIndex = roster.fetchedAt ? buildRoster(roster.entries) : null
169:

172:  let added = 0
173:  let updated = 0
174:  // Slugs only matter for new items (existing ones keep theirs), but must not repeat.
175:  const slugs = new Set<string>()
176:  const uniqueSlug = (base: string) => {
177:    let slug = base
178:    for (let n = 2; slugs.has(slug); n++) slug = `${base}-${n}`
179:    slugs.add(slug)
180:    return slug
181:  }
182:  for (let start = 0; start < unique.length; start += batchSize) {
183:    const batch = unique.slice(start, start + batchSize).map((item) => {
184:      const result = classifyCa(item.ca, rosterIndex)
185:      ca[result.status]++
186:      return {
187:        external_id: item.externalId,
188:        slug: uniqueSlug(slugify(`${item.name} ${item.externalId}`)),
189:        name: item.name,
190:        category: item.category,
191:        description: item.description,
192:        price: catalogPrice(item.cost, item.mapPrice, markupPercent),
193:        sku: item.sku,
194:        upc: item.upc,
195:        manufacturer: item.manufacturer,
196:        distributor_quantity: item.quantity,
197:        image_url: item.imageUrl,
198:        specs: item.specs,
199:        ffl_required: item.fflRequired,
200:        ca_status: result.status,
201:        ca_reason: result.reason,
202:        cost: item.cost,
203:        map_price: item.mapPrice,
204:        msrp: item.msrp,
205:      }
206:    })
207:    const { data, error } = await admin.rpc('import_catalog_items', {
208:      p_source: source,
209:      p_items: batch,
210:      p_synced_at: syncedAt,
211:      p_new_status: newStatus,
212:    })

215:    added += counts.added
216:    updated += counts.updated
217:  }

219:  // Only after every batch succeeded: a failed import never empties stock.
220:  let soldOut = 0
221:  if (complete) {

223:      .from('products')
224:      .update({ distributor_quantity: 0 })
225:      .eq('source', source)
226:      .gt('distributor_quantity', 0)
227:      .or(`synced_at.is.null,synced_at.lt.${syncedAt}`)
228:      .select('id')
229:    failOn(error)

231:  }

[Source raw SHA256:fef0dbb42476675c78d09587a1579f8d4d4d12e8d7783bfe1274f5d44290f011]
1:/**
2: * Automatic California status for an imported item, from the distributor's
3: * data and the DOJ handgun roster. Rules, first match wins:
4: *
5: * - The distributor marks it not CA compliant, it needs an SOT (NFA items),
6: *   it is a suppressor part, or a .50 BMG firearm: restricted.
7: * - Magazines: over 10 rounds restricted, 10 or fewer compliant.
8: * - Handguns: compliant only when the manufacturer's model number appears
9: *   word-for-word in a current roster entry of the same make with the same
10: *   barrel length, and it ships with magazines of 10 rounds or fewer.
11: *   Look-alike model numbers never count: "365-9-BXR3P" is not the roster's
12: *   "365-9-BXR3P-MS-CA". Not on the roster: restricted, except single-shot
13: *   and single-action guns, which may be exempt and go to review.
14: * - Long guns: manual actions holding 10 or fewer compliant; semi-autos go
15: *   to review (assault-weapon features aren't in the feed).
16: * - Ammunition, optics and ordinary accessories: compliant. Parts that may be
17: *   regulated (receivers, triggers, kits, knives, …): review.
18: *
19: * Anything else, or anything missing the data a rule needs, is 'review', so
20: * the shop's CA filter only ever shows items a rule positively cleared.
21: * Staff can override any item; imports then leave it alone (ca_manual).
22: */
23:import type { RosterEntry } from './caRoster'
24:
25:export interface CaInput {
26:  itemType: string // Firearm, Accessory, Optic, Ammo
27:  type: string // Semi-Auto Pistol, Rifle, Accessory-Magazines, …
28:  action: string
29:  manufacturer: string
30:  modelNo: string
31:  capacity: string // "10 + 1", "15", ""
32:  barrelLength: string // '4.25"'
33:  caliber: string
34:  text: string // descriptions and features
35:  sotRequired: boolean
36:}
37:
38:export interface CaResult { status: CaStatus, reason: string }
39:
40:const handgunTypes = new Set(['Semi-Auto Pistol', 'Revolver', 'Specialty Handgun'])
41:const longGunTypes = new Set(['Rifle', 'Shotgun', 'Combo'])
42:const manualActions = new Set(['Bolt Action', 'Lever Action', 'Pump Action', 'Single Shot', 'Over / Under', 'Side By Side'])
43:const exemptHandgunActions = new Set(['Single Action', 'Single Shot'])
44:const clearAccessories = new Set([
45:  'Bases and Mounts', 'Barrels', 'Batteries', 'Binoculars', 'Bipods', 'Cases', 'Charging Handles',
46:  'Chokes/Choke Tools', 'Cleaning', 'CO2 Cartridges', 'Flash Hiders', 'Forends', 'Grips', 'Handguards',
47:  'Holsters', 'Lasers and Sights', 'Lights', 'Lights and Lasers', 'Locks', 'Magazine Loaders',
48:  'Magazine Pouches', 'Monocular', 'Muzzle Brakes', 'Rails', 'Range Bags', 'Range Finders',
49:  'Range Finding Bino', 'Rings & Ring Mounts', 'Scopes', 'Slide Assemblies', 'Slings and Swivels',
50:  'Spotting Scopes', 'Stocks', 'Thermal', 'Thermal Binocular', 'Tools', 'Uppers',
51:])
52:
53:const compliant = (reason: string): CaResult => ({ status: 'compliant', reason })
54:const restricted = (reason: string): CaResult => ({ status: 'restricted', reason })
55:const review = (reason: string): CaResult => ({ status: 'review', reason })
56:
57:/** Letters and digits only, upper case: "MK-25 (CA)" → "MK25CA". */
58:const compact = (text: string) => text.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '')
59:
60:/** Leading round count: "10 + 1" → 10; null when not given. */
61:function rounds(capacity: string) {
62:  const m = capacity.match(/^\s*(\d+)/)
63:  return m ? Number(m[1]) : null
64:}
65:
66:/** '4.25"', '3 1/2"', '3-1/2"' → inches; null when not given. */
67:function inches(text: string) {
68:  const m = text.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)(?:[\s-]+(\d+)\/(\d+))?/)
69:  if (!m) return null
70:  return Number(m[1]) + (m[2] ? Number(m[2]) / Number(m[3]) : 0)
71:}
72:
73:/**
74: * Manufacturer as one key, so the distributor's and the DOJ's spellings meet:
75: * "Smith and Wesson" / "Smith & Wesson", "Ruger" / "Sturm, Ruger & Co.".
76: */
77:const brandAliases: [RegExp, string][] = [
78:  [/^shark coast/, 'shark coast'], // its own maker, despite "/ SIG"
79:  [/dan wesson/, 'dan wesson'],
80:  [/smith (&|and) wesson|^s ?& ?w\b/, 'smith wesson'],
81:  [/ruger/, 'ruger'],
82:  [/^sig\b/, 'sig'],
83:  [/^ceska|^cz\b/, 'cz'],
84:  [/^heckler|^hk\b/, 'hk'],
85:  [/european american|^eaa\b|^girsan/, 'eaa'],
86:  [/^fabrique nationale|^fn\b/, 'fn'],
87:  [/^rock island|^armscor/, 'armscor'],
88:  [/^kel ?tec/, 'keltec'],
89:]
90:export function brandKey(name: string) {
91:  const n = name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9& ]+/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()
92:  for (const [pattern, key] of brandAliases) if (pattern.test(n)) return key
93:  return n.split(' ')[0] ?? ''
94:}
95:
96:/** Model numbers named in a roster entry: "686-6 M686 SKU 150713 / Stainless" → {6866, M686, SKU, 150713}. */
97:function rosterTokens(model: string) {
98:  const name = model.split(' / ')[0] ?? model
99:  return new Set(name.split(/[\s,;()]+/).map(compact).filter(t => t.length >= 3))
100:}
101:
102:export interface Roster {
103:  byBrand: Map<string, { entry: RosterEntry, tokens: Set<string> }[]>
104:}
105:
106:export function buildRoster(entries: RosterEntry[], today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)): Roster {
107:  const byBrand: Roster['byBrand'] = new Map()
108:  for (const entry of entries) {
109:    if (entry.expires_on && entry.expires_on < today) continue
110:    const key = brandKey(entry.make)
111:    if (!byBrand.has(key)) byBrand.set(key, [])
112:    byBrand.get(key)!.push({ entry, tokens: rosterTokens(entry.model) })
113:  }
114:  return { byBrand }
115:}
116:
117:function classifyHandgun(item: CaInput, roster: Roster | null): CaResult {
118:  if (!roster) return review('The CA handgun roster could not be downloaded.')
119:  const capacity = rounds(item.capacity)
120:  const exemptAction = exemptHandgunActions.has(item.action)
121:  const models = roster.byBrand.get(brandKey(item.manufacturer)) ?? []
122:  const modelNo = compact(item.modelNo)
123:  // A usable model number has a digit and some length; "1911" or "P" alone would match too much.
124:  const hits = modelNo.length >= 4 && /\d/.test(modelNo) ? models.filter(m => m.tokens.has(modelNo)) : []
125:  const barrel = inches(item.barrelLength)
126:  const sameBarrel = hits.filter((m) => {
127:    const listed = inches(m.entry.barrel_length)
128:    return barrel === null || listed === null || Math.abs(listed - barrel) < 0.2
129:  })
130:
131:  if (sameBarrel.length) {
132:    if (capacity !== null && capacity > 10) return restricted(`Ships with ${capacity}-round magazines; California allows 10.`)
133:    const m = sameBarrel[0]!.entry
134:    return compliant(`On the CA handgun roster: ${m.make} ${m.model}${m.expires_on ? ` (listed until ${m.expires_on})` : ''}.`)
135:  }
136:  if (hits.length) return review(`Model number ${item.modelNo} is on the CA roster, but with a different barrel length.`)
137:  if (exemptAction) return review(`${item.action} handgun not on the CA roster; check whether it qualifies for an exemption.`)
138:  if (!models.length) return restricted(`No ${item.manufacturer} handguns are on the CA roster.`)
139:  return restricted(`Model ${item.modelNo || '(none given)'} is not on the CA handgun roster.`)
140:}
141:
142:export function classifyCa(item: CaInput, roster: Roster | null): CaResult {
143:  const text = `${item.text} ${item.type}`
144:  const firearm = item.itemType === 'Firearm'
145:  const accessory = item.type.replace(/^Accessory-/, '')
146:  const capacity = rounds(item.capacity)
147:
148:  if (/\bNOT\s+(CA|CALIF\w*)\b|\bNON[-\s]?(CA|CALIF\w*)\b/i.test(text)) return restricted('The distributor lists it as not California compliant.')
149:  if (item.sotRequired) return restricted('NFA item (SOT required); not sold in California.')
150:  if (/silencer|suppressor/i.test(item.type)) return restricted('Suppressors and suppressor parts are illegal in California.')
151:  if (firearm && /50 ?BMG/i.test(item.caliber)) return restricted('.50 BMG rifles are banned in California.')
152:
153:  if (item.type === 'Accessory-Magazines') {
154:    if (capacity === null) return review('Magazine capacity not listed.')
155:    return capacity > 10
156:      ? restricted(`Holds ${capacity} rounds; California limits magazines to 10.`)
157:      : compliant(`Holds ${capacity} rounds (10 or fewer).`)
158:  }
159:
160:  if (firearm && handgunTypes.has(item.type)) return classifyHandgun(item, roster)
161:  if (item.type === 'Muzzleloader') return compliant('Muzzleloader.')
162:  if (firearm && longGunTypes.has(item.type)) {
163:    if (!manualActions.has(item.action)) {
164:      return review(`${item.action || 'Unknown'} action: check California assault-weapon features before selling.`)
165:    }
166:    if (capacity === null) return review('Capacity not listed.')
167:    if (capacity > 10) return review(`Holds ${capacity} rounds; fine for a fixed tube magazine, not for a detachable one. Check it.`)
168:    return compliant(`${item.action} ${item.type.toLowerCase()} holding ${capacity} or fewer rounds.`)
169:  }
170:  if (firearm) return review('Receiver, frame or other regulated firearm part.')
171:
172:  if (item.itemType === 'Ammo' || item.type === 'Accessory-Ammunition') {
173:    return compliant('Ammunition; the buyer needs California\'s ammunition eligibility check at pickup.')
174:  }
175:  if (item.itemType === 'Optic' || clearAccessories.has(accessory)) return compliant('Accessory with no California restriction.')
176:  return review('Accessory type that California may regulate; check it.')
177:}

1:#!/usr/bin/env bash
2:# Role checks for the dashboard API routes (server/api/admin), using the
3:# seeded local accounts from supabase/seed.sql. Needs `supabase start` and
4:# `pnpm dev` running. Usage: bash scripts/check-admin-api.sh [base-url]
5:# Exits non-zero if any check fails. Restores the seeded roles it changes.
6:set -u
7:BASE=${1:-http://localhost:3000}
8:set -a; . ./.env; set +a
9:API=$NUXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
10:KEY=$NUXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_KEY
11:STAFF_ID=00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000ad03
12:ADMIN_ID=00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000ad01
13:OWNER_ID=00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000ad04
14:failures=0
15:
16:# Session cookie the way @supabase/ssr stores it: base64url JSON, prefixed.
17:session_cookie() {
18:  local session
19:  session=$(curl -s "$API/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password" -H "apikey: $KEY" \
20:    -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{\"email\":\"$1@admin.test\",\"password\":\"admin\"}")
21:  printf 'sb-127-auth-token=base64-%s' "$(printf '%s' "$session" | base64 | tr -d '\n=' | tr '+/' '-_')"
22:}
23:
24:# expect <status> <label> <cookie> <method> <path> [json body]
25:expect() {
26:  local want=$1 label=$2 cookie=$3 method=$4 path=$5 body=${6:-}
27:  local got
28:  if [ -n "$body" ]; then
29:    got=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -b "$cookie" -X "$method" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "$body" "$BASE$path")
30:  else
31:    got=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -b "$cookie" -X "$method" "$BASE$path")
32:  fi
33:  if [ "$got" = "$want" ]; then echo "ok   $label ($got)"; else echo "FAIL $label: expected $want, got $got"; failures=$((failures + 1)); fi
34:}
35:
36:AI='{"ai":{"defaultProvider":"local","localUrl":"http://localhost:11434/v1","models":{"local":"llama3.1","openai":"gpt-4.1-mini","anthropic":"claude-sonnet-4-5","gemini":"gemini-2.5-flash"}}}'
37:KEYBODY='{"secrets":{"openai_api_key":"sk-test-abcd1234"}}'
38:
39:ADMIN=$(session_cookie admin)
40:OWNER=$(session_cookie owner)
41:MANAGER=$(session_cookie manager)
42:STAFF=$(session_cookie staff)
43:
44:expect 401 'signed out: team list' '' GET /api/admin/staff
45:expect 403 'staff: team list' "$STAFF" GET /api/admin/staff
46:expect 403 'staff: settings' "$STAFF" GET /api/admin/settings
47:expect 403 'staff: save settings' "$STAFF" PUT /api/admin/settings "$AI"
48:expect 200 'manager: team list' "$MANAGER" GET /api/admin/staff
49:expect 200 'manager: settings' "$MANAGER" GET /api/admin/settings
50:expect 200 'manager: save AI settings' "$MANAGER" PUT /api/admin/settings "$AI"
51:expect 403 'manager: save an API key' "$MANAGER" PUT /api/admin/settings "$KEYBODY"
52:expect 403 'manager: promote staff to manager' "$MANAGER" PATCH "/api/admin/staff/$STAFF_ID" '{"role":"manager"}'
53:expect 403 'manager: change the admin' "$MANAGER" PATCH "/api/admin/staff/$ADMIN_ID" '{"role":"staff"}'
54:expect 403 'owner: change the admin' "$OWNER" PATCH "/api/admin/staff/$ADMIN_ID" '{"role":"owner"}'

## assistant

CSV import, the clickable home-page star, the in-store vs. order split, and a new `/shop` page with a "California compliant only" switch are all built and working against your local database. One caveat up front: the automatic California check is my own rule set, not a legal compliance service, and you should treat it that way.

**What changed**
- **Inventory page:**
  - An **Import CSV** button for managers and up. It takes the Lipsey's export and a markup % (defaults to 20%; you never gave a number).
  - The **star is now a button** that turns home-page featuring on and off, and featured items sort to the top.
  - Search and filters (stock, CA status, publish status) run in the database 50 rows at a time, since imports add thousands of items.
- **In store vs. order:** the existing quantity is now labelled "In store" and imports never change it. Distributor stock is kept separately. The shop says "In store" or "Available to order", and never calls distributor stock in stock.
- **Pricing:** imported price is dealer cost plus markup, never below MAP. On the full import, 0 items came out below MAP or below cost + 20%. Dealer cost, MAP and MSRP are stored in a staff-only table and appear only in the item editor.
- **Reimporting keeps your edits:** names, descriptions, photos, featured, published status and in-store counts. If you type a price or pick a CA status by hand, later imports leave it alone. New items come in as drafts unless you choose to publish them straight away.
- **Order editor:** the item picker now searches as you type and shows where the stock is ("2 in store · 15 at Lipsey's").
- **Shop:** the new `/shop` page has search, category, sort, "California compliant only" and "In store now". All "Shop" links now point there instead of the external storefront.
- **Item page:** shows the distributor's photo if you haven't added one, plus specs, a CA badge and an "ordered in" note.

**How California status is decided**
Each item gets compliant, restricted or needs review. The shop filter only shows items marked compliant.
- **Handguns** count as compliant only when the model number matches a current entry on the DOJ roster, with the same make, barrel length and caliber, and magazines of 10 rounds or fewer. If any of that data is missing it goes to review. If the saved roster copy is over a month old, no handgun can be marked compliant.
- **Magazines:** 10 rounds or fewer is compliant, more is restricted.
- **Long guns:** manual actions holding 10 or fewer are compliant. All semi-autos go to review, because assault-weapon features aren't in the feed.
- **Ammo, optics and common accessories** are compliant. Suppressors, NFA items, .50 BMG and anything the distributor marks "not CA" are restricted.

On your catalog that gave 5,411 compliant, 2,058 restricted and 2,120 needing review. Spot checks of handgun matches looked correct (for example the Hellcat with SKU HC9319BOSPCA). These rules are not legally verified, so please review the results; your manual settings always win. For something dependable, the paid service Lipsey's uses (Orchid eState) is the option to look at.

**Testing**
- Typecheck passes. Lint is clean except two errors in `useActiveSection.ts`, a file you'd already changed and I didn't touch.
- I imported the real 9,589-row file twice and got the same result both times.
- A partial "complete" file marked the missing items out of stock at Lipsey's, and the full file brought them back.
- A test item kept its hand-set name, price, CA status, in-store count and featured flag across reimports.
- An empty file is refused rather than wiping stock.
- Access checks: staff can't import (403), signed-out users can't either (401), and visitors can't see costs, the roster or drafts, or run the import directly.

**Not checked yet**
- **Admin screens on screen:** I didn't view the Inventory page, item editor or order picker in the browser. The browser tool's request limit stopped the app's scripts from loading. For the same reason the `/shop` screenshots used CSS I injected by hand, so the filter switches weren't clicked live.
- **Database setup:** I changed the migration file after first applying it and patched the local database by hand. Rebuilding the database from the migrations hasn't been tested.
- **Leftover data:** your local database now has 9,589 Lipsey's items, all drafts.
- **Lipsey's photos:** permission to use their catalog photos on the site isn't confirmed.

## assistant

I added delete buttons and Shift/Ctrl multi-select to the Inventory list. Lint, the type check and a production build pass, and the delete itself works against the local database. I couldn't test the clicks in a browser: the browser tool blocked most of the page's script files, and the admin pages only render once those load.

**How it works (`app/pages/admin/inventory.vue`):**
- **Red trash icon on each row** deletes that item after asking you to confirm.
- **Checkbox column** with a select-all box for the current page. Once anything is selected, a bar shows the count with **Clear** and a red **Delete** button.
- **Ctrl-click (⌘-click on Mac)** a row to add it to or remove it from the selection.
- **Shift-click** selects every row between the last row you clicked and this one. **Ctrl/⌘+Shift-click** adds that range to what's already selected.
- **A plain click** still opens the product editor. Modifier-clicks don't highlight the row text.
- **What deletion removes:** the products, their photo records and their uploaded photo files. It deletes up to 100 items at a time and reloads the list when done. If you delete imported Lipsey's items, the confirmation warns you. The selection clears itself when you change filters or pages, and when an item is deleted from the editor.

**Tested:**
- `eslint` on the page and `nuxt typecheck` both pass. I fixed one leftover lint error from the first pass.
- Using a staff login, I ran the same two database calls the page makes on 6 throwaway products, one with a photo record. I read the photo paths, then deleted the products: all 6 and the photo record were gone. A signed-out delete request was refused, and the product it targeted is still there.

**Not tested:** the clicking itself — Shift/Ctrl selection, the checkboxes, the bulk bar and the confirm dialog — and whether the uploaded photo files are actually removed from storage. A quick try at `/admin/inventory` would confirm them.

Any staff account can delete items, the same as the existing Delete button in the product editor. If only managers should be able to delete, I can restrict it.

1:<script setup lang="ts">
2:/*
3: * Laser-stipple artwork for the home hero.
4: * Dots follow a topographic field (the look of a stippled grip texture) and are
5: * tinted in steel temper colors. On load a laser line writes them in from top to
6: * bottom; afterwards dots near the mouse heat up. Colors come from the
7: * --stipple-* CSS tokens so light and dark mode both work.
8: *
9: * `layout`: 'hero' dissolves toward the left (text side); 'band' fills the
10: * open space of the shop screen: a cloud top-right beside the heading and a
11: * thin stream along the bottom edge, leaving the product row clear.
12: */
13:const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
14:  delay?: number
15:  layout?: 'hero' | 'band'
16:  /** The laser pass waits until this is true (e.g. its deck section is on screen). */
17:  active?: boolean
18:  /** false: no laser line; the dots are simply there (fade the element in with CSS). */
19:  scan?: boolean
20:}>(), { delay: 0, layout: 'hero', active: true, scan: true })
21:
22:const host = ref<HTMLDivElement>()
23:const canvas = ref<HTMLCanvasElement>()

25:type Dot = { x: number, y: number, s: number }
26:
27:const SCAN_MS = 2400 // duration of the laser pass
28:const TRAIL = 90 // px over which written dots fade to full strength
29:const BURN = 16 // px behind the laser where dots still glow hot
30:const REACH = 120 // px radius of the mouse heat
31:
32:let ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D | null = null
33:let width = 0
34:let height = 0
35:let groups: Dot[][] = [] // one list per palette color, so fillStyle changes 4×/frame
36:let palette: string[] = []
37:let hot = '#fff'
38:let reduceMotion = false
39:let scanStart = 0
40:let scanning = false
41:let raf = 0
42:const pointer = { x: 0, y: 0, inside: false }
43:
44:/* Deterministic randomness so the artwork is the same on every visit. */
45:function random(seed: number) {
46:  return () => {
47:    seed = (seed + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0
48:    let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed)
49:    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t
50:    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296
51:  }

54:const smoothstep = (a: number, b: number, x: number) => {

60:/* Smooth height field in pixel space; its contour bands drive dot density. */
61:function field(x: number, y: number) {
62:  const u = x / 240
63:  const v = y / 240
64:  return Math.sin(u * 1.25 + Math.sin(v * 0.85) * 1.7) + 0.8 * Math.sin(v * 1.15 - Math.sin(u * 0.7) * 1.45)
65:}

67:function generate() {
68:  const rand = random(1957)
69:  const cell = 3.1
70:  groups = [[], [], [], []]
71:  for (let gy = 0; gy < height; gy += cell) {
72:    for (let gx = 0; gx < width; gx += cell) {
73:      const x = gx + rand() * cell
74:      const y = gy + rand() * cell
75:      // 'hero': dissolve toward the text side. 'band': top-right cloud + bottom stream.
76:      const fade = props.layout === 'band'
77:        ? Math.max(
78:            Math.exp(-(((y / height - 0.2) / 0.13) ** 2)) * smoothstep(0.38, 0.85, x / width),
79:            Math.exp(-(((y / height - 0.97) / 0.07) ** 2)),
80:          )
81:        : smoothstep(0, 0.65, x / width)
82:      const f = field(x, y)
83:      const band = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.cos(f * Math.PI * 2.3)
84:      const density = fade * (0.05 + 0.95 * band ** 4)
85:      if (rand() >= density) continue
86:      const tone = Math.min(3, Math.max(0, Math.floor(((f + 1.8) / 3.6) * 4)))
87:      groups[tone]!.push({ x, y, s: 1 + rand() * 0.7 })
88:    }
89:  }
90:}

92:function readPalette() {

98:function draw(now: number) {

100:  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height)
101:
102:  const progress = scanning ? Math.min(1, (now - scanStart) / SCAN_MS) : 1
103:  const laserY = scanning ? easeInOut(progress) * (height + TRAIL) : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY
104:  const heated: { dot: Dot, heat: number }[] = []
105:  const reach2 = REACH * REACH
106:
107:  groups.forEach((dots, tone) => {
108:    ctx!.fillStyle = palette[tone]!
109:    for (const dot of dots) {
110:      if (dot.y > laserY) continue
111:      const behind = laserY - dot.y
112:      if (behind < BURN) {
113:        heated.push({ dot, heat: 1 - behind / BURN })
114:        continue
115:      }
116:      if (pointer.inside) {
117:        const dx = dot.x - pointer.x
118:        const dy = dot.y - pointer.y
119:        const d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy
120:        if (d2 < reach2) heated.push({ dot, heat: (1 - Math.sqrt(d2) / REACH) ** 1.5 })
121:      }
122:      ctx!.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, behind / TRAIL) * 0.85
123:      ctx!.fillRect(dot.x, dot.y, dot.s, dot.s)
124:    }
125:  })
126:
127:  // Hot dots: fresh laser burns and dots under the mouse.
128:  ctx.fillStyle = hot
129:  for (const { dot, heat } of heated) {
130:    const size = dot.s * (1 + heat * 0.9)
131:    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35 + heat * 0.65
132:    ctx.fillRect(dot.x - (size - dot.s) / 2, dot.y - (size - dot.s) / 2, size, size)
133:  }
134:
135:  // The laser line itself, with a short glow trailing above it.
136:  if (scanning && laserY < height) {
137:    const glow = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, laserY - 40, 0, laserY)
138:    glow.addColorStop(0, 'transparent')
139:    glow.addColorStop(1, hot)
140:    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.18
141:    ctx.fillStyle = glow
142:    ctx.fillRect(0, laserY - 40, width, 40)
143:    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9
144:    ctx.fillStyle = hot
145:    ctx.fillRect(0, laserY, width, 1)
146:  }
147:  ctx.globalAlpha = 1
148:
149:  if (scanning && progress >= 1) scanning = false
150:}

32:      supabase
33:        .from('products')

36:        .eq('featured', true)
37:        .order('sort_order')
38:        .order('sort_order', { referencedTable: 'product_images' })
39:        .limit(1, { referencedTable: 'product_images' })
40:        .limit(24),

42:    if (hero.error) console.error('[home] hero photos:', hero.error.message)
43:    if (featured.error) console.error('[home] featured products:', featured.error.message)
44:
45:    const photos: ShowcasePhoto[] = ((hero.data ?? []) as HeroRow[]).map(row => ({
46:      label: row.label,
47:      alt: row.alt || row.label,
48:      src: row.path ? publicUrl(row.path) : undefined,
49:    }))
50:    const products: Product[] = ((featured.data ?? []) as FeaturedRow[]).map(row => ({
51:      slug: row.slug,
52:      name: row.name,
53:      category: row.category,
54:      price: row.price,
55:      image: coverImage(row.product_images, row.image_url, publicUrl),

57:    return { photos, products }
58:  })

60:  return {
61:    photos: computed(() => data.value?.photos.length ? data.value.photos : placeholderPhotos),

140:/** Toggle (plain/Ctrl/⌘) or range-select (Shift) the item at `index`. */
141:function select(event: Event, index: number) {
142:  const { shiftKey, ctrlKey, metaKey } = event as MouseEvent
143:  const id = products.value[index]?.id
144:  if (!id) return
145:  if (shiftKey && anchor !== null) {
146:    // Shift adds the range; with Ctrl/⌘ too it extends what's already selected.
147:    const next: Record<string, boolean> = ctrlKey || metaKey ? { ...selection.value } : {}
148:    for (let i = Math.min(anchor, index); i <= Math.max(anchor, index); i++) next[products.value[i]!.id] = true
149:    selection.value = next
150:    return
151:  }
152:  selection.value = selection.value[id]
153:    ? Object.fromEntries(selectedIds.value.filter(other => other !== id).map(other => [other, true]))
154:    : { ...selection.value, [id]: true }
155:  anchor = index
156:}

159:function onRowClick(event: Event, index: number, product: ProductRow) {

161:  // On a Mac, Ctrl-click is a right click and was handled in onRowContextmenu.
162:  if (e.ctrlKey && Date.now() - contextToggleAt < 500) return

166:function onRowContextmenu(event: Event, index: number) {

171:}

178:const deleting = ref(false)
179:
180:async function deleteProducts(ids: string[]) {
181:  if (!ids.length || deleting.value) return
182:  const items = products.value.filter(p => ids.includes(p.id))
183:  const what = items.length === 1 ? `"${items[0]!.name}"` : `${items.length} items`
184:  const imported = items.some(p => p.source !== 'manual')
185:    ? '\n\nImported items come back as drafts on the next catalog import; set them to Archived to hide them for good.'
186:    : ''
187:  if (!window.confirm(`Delete ${what} and ${items.length === 1 ? 'its' : 'their'} photos? This can't be undone.${imported}`)) return
188:  deleting.value = true
189:  let deleted = 0
190:  try {
191:    // In chunks, so the id lists stay within URL limits.
192:    for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i += 100) {
193:      const chunk = ids.slice(i, i + 100)
194:      const { data: images } = check(await supabase.from('product_images').select('path').in('product_id', chunk))
195:      check(await supabase.from('products').delete().in('id', chunk))
196:      deleted += chunk.length
197:      await removePhotos((images ?? []).map(image => image.path))
198:    }
199:    notify(deleted === 1 ? 'Item deleted' : `${deleted} items deleted`)
200:  }
201:  catch (err) {
202:    notifyError(err, deleted ? `Deleted ${deleted} of ${ids.length} items, then failed` : 'Couldn\'t delete')
203:  }
204:  finally {
205:    deleting.value = false
206:    await load()
207:  }
208:}

## assistant

The lag came from loading Lipsey's product photos at full size, and I fixed that plus two errors that broke pages. Lint and the type check pass on the changed files, and I re-checked everything against your running dev server in a headless Chromium.

**What was causing the lag:** the import fills the inventory list with Lipsey's photos, and I was loading them at full size. Some are 3–6 MB and up to 6000 px wide, so a 50-row page could decode hundreds of megabytes just to show 40 px thumbnails.
- `nuxt.config.ts` now allows `www.lipseyscloud.com` as an image source. The site's image server shrinks those photos before sending them.
- Inventory thumbnails and the editor's imported-photo preview now use that resizing. The shop, product and home pages already did, but had been getting the full-size originals because the host wasn't allowed. Now they get resized versions too.
- The result: a 3 MB, 3679 px photo now comes through as a 1.6 KB, 80 px thumbnail. A full inventory page now loads about 38 KB of images, and browsers cache them for a year.

**Errors fixed:**
1. **`/shop` crashed with a 500 error once the page loaded in the browser.** The "All categories" option used an empty value, which the dropdown component doesn't allow. It now uses "all". This was my bug from the shop page: last time I only checked the server-rendered HTML, so I missed it. The page now loads cleanly, and the CA toggle switches to `?ca=1`.
2. **The home page laser animation threw a canvas error** (`createLinearGradient … non-finite`) while waiting to start. `StippleField.vue` now stays hidden until the scan begins, and the error is gone.

**Still showing, not fixed:**
- **"No match found for /services, /services/gunsmithing":** the nav and home page link to service pages that don't exist yet; only `/services/cerakote` does. Fixing these means building those pages or changing the links. Tell me which you'd like.
- **`[unhead]` warnings** (deprecated `twitter:card`, missing descriptions on dashboard pages): these are SEO hints that only show in development, not errors.
- **About 100 ms of work per inventory render.** In dev mode, each 50-row inventory page still takes about this long to draw. A production build should be faster, but I haven't measured it.

The shop shows no items with the "California compliant only" switch on because all 9,589 imported items are still drafts. I didn't check resized photos on a live shop listing; I confirmed the resizing directly and in the inventory list. Headless Chromium on this machine won't show lag the way your browser does, so it's worth clicking through once on your side to confirm it feels smooth.

6:import * as z from 'zod'

8:const options = z.object({
9:  source: z.enum(Object.keys(catalogSources) as [CatalogSource]),
10:  markupPercent: z.coerce.number().min(0).max(500),
11:  complete: z.enum(['true', 'false']).transform(v => v === 'true'),
12:  newStatus: z.enum(['draft', 'active']),
13:})

15:const maxBytes = 50 * 1024 * 1024
16:
17:export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
18:  const { admin, userId } = await requireStaff(event, 'manager')
19:  const parts = await readMultipartFormData(event)
20:  const file = parts?.find(p => p.name === 'file' && p.filename)
21:  if (!file) throw createError({ statusCode: 400, statusMessage: 'Choose a CSV file to import.' })
22:  if (file.data.length > maxBytes) throw createError({ statusCode: 413, statusMessage: 'The file is over 50 MB.' })
23:
24:  const fields = Object.fromEntries((parts ?? []).filter(p => !p.filename && p.name).map(p => [p.name!, p.data.toString('utf8')]))
25:  const parsedOptions = options.safeParse(fields)
26:  if (!parsedOptions.success) throw createError({ statusCode: 400, statusMessage: z.prettifyError(parsedOptions.error) })

30:    rows = parseCsv(file.data.toString('utf8'))
31:  }
32:  catch (err) {

34:  }
