63:  const [version, iv, data] = stored.split(':')
64:  if (version !== 'v1' || !iv || !data) throw new Error('Unrecognized secret format')
65:  const plain = await crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv: fromBase64(iv) }, key, fromBase64(data))
66:  return new TextDecoder().decode(plain)
67:}
68:
69:/* ---- Secret storage ------------------------------------------------------ */
70:export async function getSecretStatuses(admin: AdminClient) {
71:  const { data, error } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('name, last4, updated_at')
72:  failOn(error)
73:  return Object.fromEntries(secretNames.map((name) => {
74:    const row = data?.find(r => r.name === name)
75:    return [name, { set: !!row, last4: row?.last4 ?? '', updated_at: row?.updated_at ?? null }]
76:  })) as Record<SecretName, SecretStatus>
77:}
78:
79:/** Saves a secret, or deletes it when `value` is null or empty. */
80:export async function writeSecret(event: H3Event, admin: AdminClient, name: SecretName, value: string | null, userId: string) {
81:  const trimmed = value?.trim()
82:  if (!trimmed) {
83:    failOn((await admin.from('app_secrets').delete().eq('name', name)).error)
84:    return
85:  }
86:  const { error } = await admin.from('app_secrets').upsert({
87:    name,
88:    ciphertext: await encrypt(await requireKey(event), trimmed),
89:    last4: trimmed.slice(-4),
90:    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
91:    updated_by: userId,
92:  })
93:  failOn(error)
94:}
95:
96:/** The decrypted secret, or '' when it isn't set. */
97:export async function readSecret(event: H3Event, admin: AdminClient, name: SecretName) {
98:  const { data, error } = await admin.from('app_secrets').select('ciphertext').eq('name', name).maybeSingle()
99:  failOn(error)
100:  if (!data) return ''
101:  const key = await requireKey(event)
102:  try {
103:    return await decrypt(key, data.ciphertext)
104:  }
105:  catch {
106:    throw createError({
107:      statusCode: 500,
108:      statusMessage: `Could not decrypt ${name}. The encryption key changed; save the key again in Settings.`,
109:    })
110:  }
111:}


[server/utils/staff.ts#7AA7]
[Source raw SHA256:7aa7e0c8275bf1fa3976b09fb93e8ccc9b2c6dcd8ff3da15a29fea55e1d9d493]
1:/**
2: * Server-side role checks for the dashboard API routes. Every route under
3: * server/api/admin starts with `requireStaff`, which also hands back a
4: * service-role client: it bypasses row-level security, so the route itself
5: * is responsible for checking what the caller may do.
6: */
7:import type { H3Event } from 'h3'
8:import { serverSupabaseServiceRole, serverSupabaseUser } from '#supabase/server'
9:import type { Database } from '../../shared/types/database.types'
10:
11:/** Service-role Supabase client, typed from shared/types/database.types.ts. */
12:export type AdminClient = ReturnType<typeof serverSupabaseServiceRole<Database>>
13:
14:export async function requireStaff(event: H3Event, required: StaffRole) {
15:  const claims = await serverSupabaseUser(event).catch(() => null)
16:  const userId = claims?.sub
17:  if (!userId) throw createError({ statusCode: 401, statusMessage: 'Sign in required' })
18:
19:  const admin = serverSupabaseServiceRole(event)
20:  const { data, error } = await admin
21:    .from('staff_members')
22:    .select('email, role')
23:    .eq('user_id', userId)
24:    .maybeSingle()
25:  if (error) throw createError({ statusCode: 500, statusMessage: error.message })
26:  if (!data || !hasRole(data.role, required)) {
27:    throw createError({ statusCode: 403, statusMessage: 'Your role does not allow this' })
28:  }
29:  return { userId, email: data.email, role: data.role, admin }
30:}
31:
32:/** Turns a Supabase error into an HTTP error with its message. */
33:export function failOn(error: { message: string } | null, statusCode = 500) {
34:  if (error) throw createError({ statusCode, statusMessage: error.message })
35:}


[server/utils/csv.ts#B2F9]
[Source raw SHA256:b2f996c5e97acae22f05daa7a0698818c04129d59fd502a0eae9abcd56d18864]
1:/**
2: * Minimal RFC 4180 CSV reader: comma-separated, fields optionally quoted
3: * with "" as an escaped quote, quoted fields may span lines, CRLF or LF line
4: * ends, optional UTF-8 byte order mark. Returns one object per data row,
5: * keyed by the header row; blank lines are skipped.
6: */
7:export function parseCsv(text: string): Record<string, string>[] {
8:  const rows: string[][] = []
9:  let row: string[] = []
10:  let field = ''
11:  let quoted = false
12:  let i = text.charCodeAt(0) === 0xFEFF ? 1 : 0
13:
14:  for (; i < text.length; i++) {
15:    const c = text[i]
16:    if (quoted) {
17:      if (c === '"') {
18:        if (text[i + 1] === '"') {
19:          field += '"'
20:          i++
21:        }
22:        else quoted = false
23:      }
24:      else field += c
25:    }
26:    else if (c === '"') quoted = true
27:    else if (c === ',') {
28:      row.push(field)
29:      field = ''
30:    }
31:    else if (c === '\n' || c === '\r') {
32:      if (c === '\r' && text[i + 1] === '\n') i++
33:      row.push(field)
34:      rows.push(row)
35:      row = []
36:      field = ''
37:    }
38:    else field += c
39:  }
40:  if (quoted) throw new Error('The file ends inside a quoted field')
41:  if (field !== '' || row.length) {
42:    row.push(field)
43:    rows.push(row)
44:  }
45:
46:  const nonEmpty = rows.filter(r => r.length > 1 || r[0] !== '')
47:  const [header, ...data] = nonEmpty
48:  if (!header) return []
49:  const keys = header.map(h => h.trim())
50:  return data.map(values => Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key, k) => [key, values[k] ?? ''])))
51:}

/**
 * Counts page views for the dashboard's Stats (server/api/visit.post.ts):
 * the path and, on the first page only, the site that linked here. No cookies
 * or local storage. Dashboard pages aren't counted.
 */
export default defineNuxtPlugin(() => {
  const router = useRouter()
  let referrer = document.referrer
  let last = ''

  function send(path: string) {
    if (path === last || /^\/(admin)(\/|$)/.test(path)) return
    last = path
    const body = JSON.stringify({ path, referrer })
    referrer = ''
    // sendBeacon survives leaving the page; fetch keepalive is the fallback.
    if (!navigator.sendBeacon?.('/api/visit', new Blob([body], { type: 'application/json' }))) {
      fetch('/api/visit', { method: 'POST', body, keepalive: true, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }).catch(() => {})
    }
  }

  router.isReady().then(() => send(router.currentRoute.value.path))
  router.afterEach((to, _from, failure) => {
    if (!failure) send(to.path)
  })
})

[Source raw SHA256:d504db1cc315086e47bc10176804b2c02aee6e1ffbd286f7cf694abf1d10be5d]
1:/**
2: * Stats on the server: reading Elite's transaction report, counting website
3: * visits without cookies, and Google Search Console through a service account.
4: */
5:import type { H3Event } from 'h3'
6:import * as z from 'zod'
7:import type { TablesInsert } from '../../shared/types/database.types'
8:
9:/* ---- Elite transaction report -------------------------------------------- */
10:/** Columns the report must have (the "Transactions" export from Elite's portal). */
11:export const eliteColumns = ['Date', 'Time', 'Trans ID', 'Total', 'Status', 'Type'] as const
12:
13:const monthNumber: Record<string, string> = {
14:  Jan: '01', Feb: '02', Mar: '03', Apr: '04', May: '05', Jun: '06',
15:  Jul: '07', Aug: '08', Sep: '09', Oct: '10', Nov: '11', Dec: '12',
16:}
17:
18:/** "Oct 23, 2026" -> "2026-10-23"; null when it doesn't look like that. */
19:export function eliteDay(text: string) {
20:  const m = text.trim().match(/^([A-Z][a-z]{2})[a-z]*\.? (\d{1,2}), (\d{4})$/)
21:  const month = m && monthNumber[m[1]!]
22:  return m && month ? `${m[3]}-${month}-${m[2]!.padStart(2, '0')}` : null
23:}
24:
25:/** "03:06 PM" -> "15:06"; null when it doesn't look like that. */
26:export function eliteTime(text: string) {
27:  const m = text.trim().match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::\d{2})? ?([AP]M)$/i)
28:  if (!m) return null
29:  const hour = Number(m[1]) % 12 + (m[3]!.toUpperCase() === 'PM' ? 12 : 0)
30:  return hour < 24 && Number(m[2]) < 60 ? `${String(hour).padStart(2, '0')}:${m[2]}` : null
31:}
32:
33:/** "$1,091.73", "-$5.00" or "($5.00)" -> number; null when unreadable. */
34:export function eliteAmount(text: string) {
35:  const t = text.trim()
36:  const negative = t.startsWith('-') || (t.startsWith('(') && t.endsWith(')'))
37:  const digits = t.replace(/[$,()\s-]/g, '')
38:  if (!/^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$/.test(digits)) return null
39:  return (negative ? -1 : 1) * Number(digits)
40:}
41:
42:export interface EliteParse {
43:  rows: TablesInsert<'card_transactions'>[]
44:  /** Row numbers (1 = first data row) that couldn't be read, with why. */
45:  skipped: { row: number, reason: string }[]
46:}
47:
48:/** Card transactions from the report's rows (parseCsv output), times in shop time. */
49:export function eliteTransactions(rows: Record<string, string>[]): EliteParse {
50:  const missing = eliteColumns.filter(c => !(c in (rows[0] ?? {})))
51:  if (rows.length && missing.length) {
52:    throw createError({ statusCode: 400, statusMessage: `This isn't an Elite transaction report: missing ${missing.join(', ')}.` })
53:  }
54:  const byId = new Map<string, TablesInsert<'card_transactions'>>()
55:  const skipped: EliteParse['skipped'] = []
56:  rows.forEach((r, i) => {
57:    const day = eliteDay(r.Date ?? '')
58:    const time = eliteTime(r.Time ?? '')
59:    const total = eliteAmount(r.Total ?? '')
60:    const transId = (r['Trans ID'] ?? '').trim()
61:    const reason = !transId ? 'no Trans ID' : !day || !time ? 'unreadable date or time' : total === null ? 'unreadable total' : ''
62:    if (reason) {
63:      skipped.push({ row: i + 1, reason })
64:      return
65:    }
66:    byId.set(transId, {
67:      trans_id: transId,
68:      occurred_at: zonedInstant(day!, time!, shopTimeZone).toISOString(),
69:      cardholder: (r.Name ?? '').trim().slice(0, 120),
70:      customer: (r.Customer ?? '').trim().slice(0, 120),
71:      card_type: (r['Card Type'] ?? '').trim().slice(0, 40),
72:      bin_type: (r['BIN Type'] ?? '').trim().slice(0, 40),
73:      // Masked already ("**** 2071"); keep only the last 4 digits.
74:      last4: (r['Card Number'] ?? '').replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-4),
75:      total: total!,
76:      status: (r.Status ?? '').trim().slice(0, 40),
77:      type: (r.Type ?? '').trim().slice(0, 40),
78:      auth_code: (r.Auth ?? '').trim().slice(0, 40),
79:      source: (r.Source ?? '').trim().slice(0, 80),
80:      origin: 'csv',
81:      imported_at: new Date().toISOString(),
82:    })
83:  })
84:  return { rows: [...byId.values()], skipped }
85:}

87:/* ---- Website visits ------------------------------------------------------ */
88:const botPattern = /bot|crawl|spider|slurp|facebookexternalhit|preview|headless|lighthouse|monitor|curl|wget|python|axios|node-fetch/i
89:
90:export function isBot(userAgent: string) {
91:  return !userAgent || botPattern.test(userAgent)
92:}
93:
94:export function deviceOf(userAgent: string): 'desktop' | 'phone' | 'tablet' {
95:  if (/iPad|Tablet|Android(?!.*Mobile)/i.test(userAgent)) return 'tablet'
96:  if (/Mobi|iPhone|Android/i.test(userAgent)) return 'phone'
97:  return 'desktop'
98:}
99:
100:/** Host of an outside referrer ("google.com"), or '' for none or this site. */
101:export function referrerHost(referrer: string, siteHost: string) {
102:  try {
103:    const host = new URL(referrer).hostname.replace(/^www\./, '').toLowerCase()
104:    return host && host !== siteHost.replace(/^www\./, '').toLowerCase() ? host.slice(0, 200) : ''
105:  }
106:  catch {
107:    return ''
108:  }
109:}
110:
111:/** Today's salt (shop time), creating it and dropping older ones when the day changes. */
112:async function todaysSalt(admin: AdminClient) {
113:  const day = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: shopTimeZone }).format(new Date())
114:  const { data, error } = await admin.from('visit_salts').select('salt').eq('day', day).maybeSingle()
115:  failOn(error)
116:  if (data) return data.salt
117:  const salt = Array.from(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32)), b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')
118:  // Two requests racing at midnight: the first insert wins, the other reads it.
119:  const inserted = await admin.from('visit_salts').upsert({ day, salt }, { onConflict: 'day', ignoreDuplicates: true })
120:  failOn(inserted.error)
121:  failOn((await admin.from('visit_salts').delete().lt('day', day)).error)
122:  const again = await admin.from('visit_salts').select('salt').eq('day', day).single()
123:  failOn(again.error)
124:  return again.data!.salt
125:}
126:
127:/** Anonymous per-day visitor id: SHA-256 of salt + IP + browser, never stored raw. */
128:export async function visitorId(admin: AdminClient, ip: string, userAgent: string) {
129:  const salt = await todaysSalt(admin)
130:  const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(`${salt}|${ip}|${userAgent}`))
131:  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest).slice(0, 16), b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')
132:}

136:export async function getSearchConsoleSettings(admin: AdminClient): Promise<SearchConsoleSettings> {
137:  const { data, error } = await admin.from('app_settings').select('value').eq('key', 'search_console').maybeSingle()
138:  failOn(error)

144:  type: z.literal('service_account', 'Paste the JSON key of a Google Cloud service account.'),
145:  client_email: z.email(),
146:  private_key: z.string().includes('PRIVATE KEY'),

152:  const statuses = await getSecretStatuses(admin)
153:  return {

158:
159:const base64url = (bytes: Uint8Array | string) => {
160:  const raw = typeof bytes === 'string' ? new TextEncoder().encode(bytes) : bytes
161:  return btoa(Array.from(raw, b => String.fromCharCode(b)).join('')).replace(/=+$/, '').replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_')
162:}
163:
164:/** An OAuth access token for the service account (signed JWT grant, RS256). */
165:async function googleToken(account: z.infer<typeof serviceAccountSchema>, scope: string) {
166:  const der = Uint8Array.from(atob(account.private_key.replace(/-----[^-]+-----|\s/g, '')), c => c.charCodeAt(0))
167:  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey('pkcs8', der, { name: 'RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign'])
168:  const tokenUri = account.token_uri ?? 'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token'
169:  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)
170:  const unsigned = `${base64url(JSON.stringify({ alg: 'RS256', typ: 'JWT' }))}.${base64url(JSON.stringify({
171:    iss: account.client_email, scope, aud: tokenUri, iat: now, exp: now + 3600,
172:  }))}`
173:  const signature = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.sign('RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5', key, new TextEncoder().encode(unsigned)))
174:  const res = await $fetch<{ access_token: string }>(tokenUri, {
175:    method: 'POST',
176:    body: new URLSearchParams({ grant_type: 'urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer', assertion: `${unsigned}.${base64url(signature)}` }),
177:  })
178:  return res.access_token
179:}
180:
181:interface GscRow { keys?: string[], clicks: number, impressions: number, ctr: number, position: number }
182:
183:/** Clicks, impressions, top searches and pages from Search Console for [from, to]. */
184:export async function searchConsoleReport(event: H3Event, admin: AdminClient, from: string, to: string): Promise<SearchReport> {
185:  const settings = await getSearchConsoleSettings(admin)
186:  const raw = await readSecret(event, admin, 'google_service_account')
187:  if (!settings.siteUrl || !raw) return { status: 'off' }
188:  try {
189:    const account = serviceAccountSchema.parse(JSON.parse(raw))
190:    const token = await googleToken(account, 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters.readonly')
191:    const url = `https://www.googleapis.com/webmasters/v3/sites/${encodeURIComponent(settings.siteUrl)}/searchAnalytics/query`
192:    const query = (dimensions: string[], rowLimit: number) => $fetch<{ rows?: GscRow[] }>(url, {
193:      method: 'POST',
194:      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
195:      body: { startDate: from, endDate: to, dimensions, rowLimit },
196:    }).then(r => r.rows ?? [])
197:    const [totals, queries, pages] = await Promise.all([query([], 1), query(['query'], 10), query(['page'], 10)])
198:    const row = (r: GscRow) => ({ label: r.keys?.[0] ?? '', clicks: r.clicks, impressions: r.impressions, position: r.position })
199:    return {
200:      status: 'ok',
201:      clicks: totals[0]?.clicks ?? 0,
202:      impressions: totals[0]?.impressions ?? 0,
203:      position: totals[0]?.position ?? null,
204:      queries: queries.map(row),
205:      pages: pages.map(r => ({ ...row(r), label: r.keys?.[0]?.replace(/^https?:\/\/[^/]+/, '') || '/' })),
206:    }
207:  }
208:  catch (err) {
209:    const e = err as { data?: { error?: { message?: string } | string, error_description?: string }, message?: string }
210:    const detail = typeof e.data?.error === 'object' ? e.data.error.message : e.data?.error_description ?? e.data?.error
211:    return { status: 'error', error: detail || e.message || 'Search Console request failed' }
212:  }
213:}

# Method: locations.fetchMultiDailyMetricsTimeSeries

[image: Spark icon]

## Page Summary

Fetches daily metrics time series data for a specified location within a given date range.

Allows retrieval of specific daily metrics, such as website clicks and call clicks.

Returns data organized by daily metric and optionally broken down by sub-entity types.

Requires authorization with the `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/business.manage` scope.

Data is presented as a list of time series, each containing date-value pairs for the corresponding metric.

- HTTP request
- Path parameters
- Query parameters
- Request body
- Response body
  - JSON representation
- Authorization scopes
- MultiDailyMetricTimeSeries
  - JSON representation
- DailyMetricTimeSeries
  - JSON representation

Returns the values for each date from a given time range and optionally the sub entity type, where applicable, that are associated with the specific daily metrics.

Example request: `GET https://businessprofileperformance.googleapis.com/v1/locations/12345:fetchMultiDailyMetricsTimeSeries?dailyMetrics=WEBSITE_CLICKS&dailyMetrics=CALL_CLICKS&dailyRange.start_date.year=2022&dailyRange.start_date.month=1&dailyRange.start_date.day=1&dailyRange.end_date.year=2022&dailyRange.end_date.month=3&dailyRange.end_date.day=31`

### HTTP request

`GET https://businessprofileperformance.googleapis.com/v1/{location=locations/*}:fetchMultiDailyMetricsTimeSeries`

The URL uses gRPC Transcoding (https://google.aip.dev/127) syntax.

### Path parameters

Parameters
`location` |

`string`

Required. The location for which the time series should be fetched. Format: locations/{locationId} where locationId is an unobfuscated listing id.

### Query parameters

Parameters
`dailyMetrics[]` |

`enum (`DailyMetric (https://developers.google.com/my-business/reference/performance/rest/v1/DailyMetric)`)`

Required. The metrics to retrieve time series for.

`dailyRange` |

`object (`DailyRange (https://developers.google.com/my-business/reference/performance/rest/v1/DailyRange)`)`

Required. The timerange for which the time series will be fetched.

### Request body

The request body must be empty.

### Response body

Represents the response for locations.fetchMultiDailyMetricsTimeSeries.

If successful, the response body contains data with the following structure:

JSON representation

```
{
  "multiDailyMetricTimeSeries": [
    {
      object (MultiDailyMetricTimeSeries (https://developers.google.com/my-business/reference/performance/rest/v1/locations/fetchMultiDailyMetricsTimeSeries))
    }
  ]
}
```

Fields
`multiDailyMetricTimeSeries[]` |

`object (`MultiDailyMetricTimeSeries (https://developers.google.com/my-business/reference/performance/rest/v1/locations/fetchMultiDailyMetricsTimeSeries)`)`

DailyMetrics and their corresponding time series.

### Authorization scopes

Requires the following OAuth scope:

- `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/business.manage`

For more information, see the OAuth 2.0 Overview (https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/OAuth2).

## MultiDailyMetricTimeSeries

Represents a list of tuples of DailyMetric-DailySubEntityType-TimeSeries.

JSON representation

```
{
  "dailyMetricTimeSeries": [
    {
      object (DailyMetricTimeSeries (https://developers.google.com/my-business/reference/performance/rest/v1/locations/fetchMultiDailyMetricsTimeSeries))
    }
  ]
}
```

Fields
`dailyMetricTimeSeries[]` |

`object (`DailyMetricTimeSeries (https://developers.google.com/my-business/reference/performance/rest/v1/locations/fetchMultiDailyMetricsTimeSeries)`)`

List of DailyMetric-TimeSeries pairs.

## DailyMetricTimeSeries

Represents a single datapoint, where each datapoint is a DailyMetric-DailySubEntityType-TimeSeries tuple.

JSON representation

```
{
  "dailyMetric": enum (DailyMetric (https://developers.google.com/my-business/reference/performance/rest/v1/DailyMetric)),
  "dailySubEntityType": {
    object (DailySubEntityType (https://developers.google.com/my-business/reference/performance/rest/v1/DailySubEntityType))
  },
  "timeSeries": {
    object (TimeSeries (https://developers.google.com/my-business/reference/performance/rest/v1/TimeSeries))
  }
}
```

Fields

`object (`TimeSeries (https://developers.google.com/my-business/reference/performance/rest/v1/TimeSeries)`)`

# DailyMetric

[image: Spark icon]

## Page Summary

Enums represent various daily performance metrics for a business, including impressions, conversations, direction requests, and website/call clicks.

Metrics cover interactions across Google Search and Maps, on both desktop and mobile devices.

Impressions are counted uniquely per user per day, regardless of the number of times the business is displayed.

The data includes business-specific actions like bookings, food orders, and menu interactions.

`DAILY_METRIC_UNKNOWN` serves as a default value for uncategorized or undefined metrics.

Represents all available daily metrics for a business.

Enums
`DAILY_METRIC_UNKNOWN` | Represents the default unknown value.
`BUSINESS_IMPRESSIONS_DESKTOP_MAPS` | Business impressions on Google Maps on Desktop devices. Multiple impressions by a unique user within a single day are counted as a single impression.
`BUSINESS_IMPRESSIONS_DESKTOP_SEARCH` | Business impressions on Google Search on Desktop devices. Multiple impressions by a unique user within a single day are counted as a single impression.
`BUSINESS_IMPRESSIONS_MOBILE_MAPS` | Business impressions on Google Maps on Mobile devices. Multiple impressions by a unique user within a single day are counted as a single impression.
`BUSINESS_IMPRESSIONS_MOBILE_SEARCH` | Business impressions on Google Search on Mobile devices. Multiple impressions by a unique user within a single day are counted as a single impression.
`BUSINESS_CONVERSATIONS` |

The number of message conversations received on the business profile.

`BUSINESS_DIRECTION_REQUESTS` | The number of times a direction request was requested to the business location.
`CALL_CLICKS` | The number of times the business profile call button was clicked.
`WEBSITE_CLICKS` | The number of times the business profile website was clicked.
`MESSAGING_CLICKS` | The number of times the business profile messaging (e.g. WhatsApp) button was clicked.
`BUSINESS_BOOKINGS` | The number of bookings made from the business profile via Reserve with Google.
`BUSINESS_FOOD_ORDERS` |

The number of food orders received from the business profile.

`BUSINESS_FOOD_MENU_CLICKS` | The number of clicks to view or interact with the menu content on the business profile. Multiple clicks by a unique user within a single day are counted as 1.

## Page Summary

- 
          The `accountSummaries.list` method returns summaries of all accounts accessible by the caller.
- 
          The HTTP request uses a GET method to `https://analyticsadmin.googleapis.com/v1beta/accountSummaries` .
- 
          You can control the number of results per page using the `pageSize` query parameter and paginate results with the`pageToken` .
- 
          The response body contains a list of `AccountSummary` objects and a`nextPageToken` for pagination.
- 
          Authorization requires one of the specified OAuth scopes, either `analytics.readonly` or`analytics.edit` .

Returns summaries of all accounts accessible by the caller.

### HTTP request

`GET https://analyticsadmin.googleapis.com/v1beta/accountSummaries`

The URL uses gRPC Transcoding syntax.

### Query parameters

| Parameters |  | 
|---|---|
| `pageSize` | `integer` Optional. The maximum number of AccountSummary resources to return. The service may return fewer than this value, even if there are additional pages. If unspecified, at most 50 resources will be returned. The maximum value is 200; (higher values will be coerced to the maximum) | 
| `pageToken` | `string` Optional. A page token, received from a previous `accountSummaries.list` call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page. When paginating, all other parameters provided to`accountSummaries.list` must match the call that provided the page token. | 

### Request body

The request body must be empty.

### Response body

Response message for accountSummaries.list RPC.

If successful, the response body contains data with the following structure:

| JSON representation | 
|---|
| {   "accountSummaries": [     {       object (`AccountSummary` )     }   ],   "nextPageToken": string } | 

| Fields |  | 
|---|---|
| `accountSummaries[]` | `object (``AccountSummary` ) Account summaries of all accounts the caller has access to. | 
| `nextPageToken` | `string` A token, which can be sent as `pageToken` to retrieve the next page. If this field is omitted, there are no subsequent pages. | 

### Authorization scopes

Requires one of the following OAuth scopes:

- `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/analytics.readonly`
- `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/analytics.edit`

## AccountSummary

A virtual resource representing an overview of an account and all its child Google Analytics properties.

| JSON representation | 
|---|
| {   "name": string,   "account": string,   "displayName": string,   "propertySummaries": [     {       object (`PropertySummary` )     }   ] } |

[]) {\\n      const n = Number(point.value ?? 0)\\n      totals[s.dailyMetric] = (totals[s.dailyMetric] ?? 0) + n\\n      const day = `${point.date.year}-${String(point.date.month).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(point.date.day).padStart(2, '0')}`\\n      const entry = byDay.get(day) ?? { impressions: 0, actions: 0 }\\n      if (impressionMetrics.includes(s.dailyMetric)) entry.impressions += n\\n      else entry.actions += n\\n      byDay.set(day, entry)\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  const report: BusinessReport = {\\n    status: 'ok',\\n    impressions: impressionMetrics.reduce((sum, m) => sum + (totals[m] ?? 0), 0),\\n    calls: totals.CALL_CLICKS ?? 0,\\n    directions: totals.BUSINESS_DIRECTION_REQUESTS ?? 0,\\n    websiteClicks: totals.WEBSITE_CLICKS ?? 0,\\n    daily: [...byDay].sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b)).map(([day, v]) => ({ day, ...v })),\\n    rating: null,\\n    reviewCount: null,\\n    recent: [],\\n  }\\n  // Reviews are only in the older v4 API, which Google enables separately.\\n  try {\\n    const reviews = await api<{\\n      averageRating?: number\\n      totalReviewCount?: number\\n      reviews?: { reviewer?: { displayName?: string }, starRating: string, comment?: string, createTime: string }[]\\n    }>(token, `https://mybusiness.googleapis.com/v4/${location}/reviews?pageSize=5&orderBy=updateTime%20desc`)\\n    report.rating = reviews.averageRating ?? null\\n    report.reviewCount = reviews.totalReviewCount ?? 0\\n    report.recent = (reviews.reviews ?? []).map(r => ({\\n      name: r.reviewer?.displayName ?? 'A Google user',\\n      stars: starCount[r.starRating] ?? 0,\\n      comment: (r.comment ??       "arguments": "{\"content\":\"/*\\n * Uploads dealer invoices or auction results as a CSV (multipart: `source`,\\n * `file`, and `mapping`, a JSON LedgerMapping). Owners and up. Without a\\n * mapping nothing is saved: the answer is a LedgerPreview with the file's\\n * columns and a suggested mapping, which the page sends back to import.\\n */\\nimport * as z from 'zod'\\n\\nconst maxBytes = 20 * 1024 * 1024\\nconst mappingSchema = z.object(Object.fromEntries(ledgerFields.map(f => [f, z.string().max(200).optional()])))\\n\\nexport default defineEventHandler(async (event): Promise<LedgerPreview | LedgerImportResult> => {\\n  const { admin, userId } = await requireStaff(event, 'owner')\\n  const parts = await readMultipartFormData(event)\\n  const field = (name: string) => parts?.find(p => p.name === name && !p.filename)?.data.toString('utf8')\\n  const source = field('source') as LedgerSource | undefined\\n  if (!source || !ledgerSourceKeys.includes(source) || source === 'sports_south') {\\n    throw createError({ statusCode: 400, statusMessage: 'Pick what the file is: Lipsey\\\\'s, another dealer or Proxibid.' })\\n  }\\n  const file = parts?.find(p => p.name === 'file' && p.filename)\\n  if (!file) throw createError({ statusCode: 400, statusMessage: 'Choose the CSV to import.' })\\n  if (file.data.length > maxBytes) throw createError({ statusCode: 413, statusMessage: 'The file is over 20 MB.' })\\n\\n  let csv: Record<string, string>[]\\n  try {\\n    csv = parseCsv(file.data.toString('utf8'))\\n  }\\n  catch (err) {\\n    throw createError({ statusCode: 400, statusMessage: `Couldn't read the CSV: ${(err as Error).message}` })\\n  }\\n  if (!csv.length) throw createError({ statusCode: 400, statusMessage: 'The file has no rows in it.' })\\n  const headers = Object.keys(csv[0]!).filter(Boolean)\\n\\n  const rawMapping = field('mapping')\\n  if (!rawMapping) {\\n    return { status: 'preview', headers, sample: csv.slice(0, 5), rows: csv.length, mapping: await ledgerMappingFor(admin, source, headers) }\\n  }\\n  let mapping: LedgerMapping\\n  try {\\n    mapping = mappingSchema.parse(JSON.parse(rawMapping)) as LedgerMapping\\n  }\\n  catch {\\n    throw createError({ statusCode: 400, statusMessage: 'The column choices didn\\\\'t come through. Try again.' })\\n  }\\n  const unknown = Object.values(mapping).find(h => h && !headers.includes(h))\\n  if (unknown) throw createError({ statusCode: 400, statusMessage: `The file has no \\\"${unknown}\\\" column.` })\\n\\n  const { rows, skipped } = ledgerRows(csv, source, mapping)\\n  if (!rows.length) throw createError({ statusCode: 400, statusMessage: 'No rows had a reference, date and amount with those columns.' })\\n  const saved = await saveLedgerRows(admin, source, rows, { origin: 'csv', fileName: file.filename, skipped: skipped.length, userId })\\n  await saveLedgerMapping(admin, source, mapping, userId)\\n  return { status: 'imported', rows: rows.length, added: saved.added, updated: saved.updated, skipped, firstOn: saved.firstOn, lastOn: saved.lastOn }\\n})\\n\",\"path\":\"server/api/admin/stats/ledger.post.ts\"}",

 * - the shared social card (public/images/og.jpg) for link previews;
 * - the shop as a LocalBusiness for search engines (address, phone, hours,
 *   map, licenses and the services it offers), from app.config's business
 *   info and the saved shop hours;
 * - the site's search (the shop's) for search engines that offer it;
 * - Search Console / Bing ownership tags, when set (runtimeConfig).
 */
const { site } = useAppConfig()
const siteUrl = useSiteConfig().url.replace(/\/$/, '')
const { lines: hours } = await useShopHours()
const { siteVerification } = useRuntimeConfig().public

useSeoMeta({
  ogImage: `${siteUrl}/images/og.jpg`,
  ogImageWidth: 1200,
  ogImageHeight: 630,
  ogImageAlt: `${site.name}, ${site.address.city}, California`,
  ogType: 'website',
  ogLocale: 'en_US',
  twitterCard: 'summary_large_image',
  googleSiteVerification: siteVerification.google || undefined,
})
useHead({
  meta: siteVerification.bing ? [{ name: 'msvalidate.01', content: siteVerification.bing }] : [],
})

// What the shop offers, for search engines matching "<service> near me".
// Worded from the site's own copy (data/capabilities.ts, transfers page).
const services = [
  { name: 'Custom gunsmithing', description: `Custom gunsmithing in ${site.address.city}, California.` },
  { name: 'Slide optic milling', description: 'Optic cuts milled into pistol slides, so the red dot sits low, square and tight to the footprint.', url: '/#what-we-do' },
  { name: 'Laser stippling', description: 'Grip texture laser stippled dot by dot, from a design you sign off on first.', url: '/#what-we-do' },
  { name: 'Laser engraving', description: 'Logos, text and artwork laser engraved into the surface.', url: '/#what-we-do' },
  { name: 'Slide porting', description: 'Ports cut through the slide to tame muzzle rise.', url: '/#what-we-do' },
  { name: 'Cerakote', description: 'A thin, hard ceramic finish sprayed and cured in the shop, in solid colors and camo patterns.', url: '/services/cerakote' },
  { name: 'FFL firearm transfers', description: 'Dealer and private-party firearm transfers and ammunition transfers, by appointment.', url: '/transfers' },
  { name: 'Firearm sales', description: 'New and used firearms, ammunition, optics, parts and accessories.', url: '/shop' },
]

useSchemaOrg([
  defineLocalBusiness({
    '@type': ['Organization', 'LocalBusiness', 'Store'],
    'areaServed': `${site.address.city}, California`,
    'name': site.name,
    'description': site.tagline,
    'url': siteUrl,
    'logo': `${siteUrl}/images/logo.png`,
    'image': `${siteUrl}/images/og.jpg`,
    'telephone': `+1${site.phone.replace(/\D/g, '')}`,
    'email': site.email,
    'hasMap': mapsUrl(site),
    'currenciesAccepted': 'USD',
    'address': {
      streetAddress: site.address.street,
      addressLocality: site.address.city,
      addressRegion: site.address.region,
      postalCode: site.address.postalCode,
      addressCountry: site.address.country,
    },
    'openingHoursSpecification': hours.value.map(h => ({ dayOfWeek: h.days, opens: h.opens, closes: h.closes })),
    'identifier': [
      { '@type': 'PropertyValue', 'name': 'Federal Firearms License', 'value': site.licenses.ffl },
      { '@type': 'PropertyValue', 'name': 'California Firearms Dealer number', 'value': site.licenses.cfd },
    ],
    'knowsAbout': services.map(s => s.name),
    'makesOffer': services.map(s => ({
      '@type': 'Offer',
      'itemOffered': {
        '@type': 'Service',
        'name': s.name,
        'description': s.description,
        'url': s.url ? `${siteUrl}${s.url}` : undefined,
        'areaServed': `${site.address.city}, California`,
      },
    })),
    'sameAs': site.social.map(s => s.to),
  }),
  defineWebSite({
    potentialAction: [defineSearchAction({ target: `${siteUrl}/shop?q={search_term_string}` })],
  }),
])
</script>

<template>
  <UApp>
    <NuxtRouteAnnouncer />
    <NuxtLayout>
      <NuxtPage />
    </NuxtLayout>
  </UApp>
</template>

/* Add or edit one expense for Stats. Owners and up (the expenses table's policy). */
import type { Tables } from '~~/shared/types/database.types'

type Expense = Tables<'expenses'>
const props = defineProps<{ expense: Expense | null, categories: string[] }>()
const open = defineModel<boolean>('open', { default: false })
const emit = defineEmits<{ saved: [], deleted: [] }>()

const { supabase, check, notify, notifyError } = useAdmin()
const today = () => zonedDate(new Date(), shopTimeZone)

const state = reactive({ spent_on: today(), category: 'Other', description: '', amount: '' })
const saving = ref(false)

watch(open, (isOpen) => {
  if (!isOpen) return
  const e = props.expense
  Object.assign(state, e
    ? { spent_on: e.spent_on, category: e.category, description: e.description, amount: String(e.amount) }
    : { spent_on: today(), category: state.category, description: '', amount: '' })
})

const categoryItems = computed(() => [...new Set([...expenseCategories, ...props.categories])])
const amount = computed(() => Number(state.amount.replace(/[$,\s]/g, '')))
const problem = computed(() => {
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(state.spent_on)) return 'Pick a date.'
  if (!state.category.trim()) return 'Pick a category.'
  if (!state.amount.trim() || !Number.isFinite(amount.value) || amount.value < 0) return 'Enter the amount.'
  return null
})

async function save() {
  if (problem.value) return
  saving.value = true
  try {
    const row = {
      spent_on: state.spent_on,
      category: state.category.trim().slice(0, 60),
      description: state.description.trim().slice(0, 300),
      amount: Math.round(amount.value * 100) / 100,
    }
    if (props.expense) check(await supabase.from('expenses').update(row).eq('id', props.expense.id))
    else check(await supabase.from('expenses').insert(row))
    notify(props.expense ? 'Expense updated' : 'Expense added')
    open.value = false
    emit('saved')
  }
  catch (err) {
    notifyError(err)
  }
  finally {
    saving.value = false
  }
}

async function remove() {
  if (!props.expense) return
  try {
    check(await supabase.from('expenses').delete().eq('id', props.expense.id))
    notify('Expense deleted')
    open.value = false
    emit('deleted')
  }
  catch (err) {
    notifyError(err, 'Couldn\'t delete')
  }
}

456:export interface PricedItem {
457:  cost: number | null
458:  mapPrice: number | null
459:  msrp: number | null
460:  category: string
461:  fflRequired: boolean
462:}
463:
464:/**
465: * Selling price for an imported item, or null for "Call for price":
466: * - guns, ammo and FFL items: MSRP (MAP if there is no MSRP);
467: * - parts: dealer cost x the matrix bracket's percent, cut to MSRP when
468: *   capAtMsrp is on (MAP if there is no cost);
469: * - never below the minimum advertised price (MAP).
470: * Always from cost, never from the current price, so changes don't stack.
471: * Same rule as public.catalog_price_detail() in the database.
472: */
473:export function catalogPrice(item: PricedItem, pricing: CatalogPricing) {
474:  const map = item.mapPrice && item.mapPrice > 0 ? item.mapPrice : null
475:  const msrp = item.msrp && item.msrp > 0 ? item.msrp : null
476:  if (usesMsrpPricing(item.category, item.fflRequired)) {
477:    return msrp === null ? map : Math.max(msrp, map ?? 0)
478:  }
479:  const cost = item.cost
480:  if (cost === null || !(cost > 0)) return map
481:  const percent = tierFor(cost, pricing.tiers)?.percent ?? 100
482:  // Work in whole cents so float error can't tip a half cent the wrong way.
483:  let price = Math.round(Math.round(cost * 100) * percent / 100) / 100
484:  if (pricing.capAtMsrp && msrp !== null && price > msrp) price = msrp
485:  return map !== null && price < map ? map : price
486:}

2:/*
3: * Upload an Elite transaction report (the CSV from Elite's portal). Sales
4: * already imported are updated, never counted twice. Owners and up.
5: */
6:const open = defineModel<boolean>('open', { default: false })
7:const emit = defineEmits<{ imported: [] }>()
8:
9:const { notify, notifyError } = useAdmin()
10:const file = ref<File | null>(null)
11:const running = ref(false)
12:const result = ref<CardImportResult | null>(null)
13:
14:watch(open, (isOpen) => {
15:  if (isOpen) {
16:    file.value = null
17:    result.value = null
18:  }
19:})
20:
21:async function run() {
22:  if (!file.value) return
23:  running.value = true
24:  try {
25:    const form = new FormData()
26:    form.append('file', file.value)
27:    result.value = await $fetch<CardImportResult>('/api/admin/stats/cards', { method: 'POST', body: form })
28:    notify('Report imported')
29:    emit('imported')
30:  }
31:  catch (err) {
32:    notifyError(err, 'Couldn\'t import the report')
33:  }
34:  finally {
35:    running.value = false
36:  }
37:}
38:
39:const day = (iso: string | null) => (iso ? formatDateTime(iso, false) : '—')
40:</script>
41:
42:<template>
43:  <UModal
44:    v-model:open="open"
45:    title="Import Elite report"
46:    description="Card sales from your Elite transaction report."
47:  >
48:    <template #body>
49:      <div
50:        v-if="result"
51:        class="grid gap-3 text-sm"
52:      >
53:        <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
54:          <AdminStatsKpi
55:            label="Sales read"
56:            :value="result.rows.toLocaleString()"
57:            icon="i-lucide-file-text"
58:          />
59:          <AdminStatsKpi
60:            label="New"
61:            :value="result.added.toLocaleString()"
62:            icon="i-lucide-plus"
63:          />
64:          <AdminStatsKpi
65:            label="Updated"
66:            :value="result.updated.toLocaleString()"
67:            icon="i-lucide-refresh-cw"
68:          />
69:        </div>
70:        <p class="text-muted">
71:          Covers {{ day(result.firstAt) }} to {{ day(result.lastAt) }}.
72:        </p>
73:        <UAlert
74:          v-if="result.skipped.length"
75:          color="warning"
76:          variant="subtle"
77:          icon="i-lucide-triangle-alert"
78:          :title="`${result.skipped.length} row${result.skipped.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} skipped`"
79:          :description="result.skipped.slice(0, 5).map(s => `Row ${s.row}: ${s.reason}`).join(' · ')"
80:        />
81:      </div>
82:      <form
83:        v-else
84:        id="elite-import-form"
85:        class="grid gap-3"
86:        @submit.prevent="run"
87:      >
88:        <UFileUpload
89:          v-model="file"
90:          accept=".csv,text/csv"
91:          label="Drop the report CSV here"
92:          description="The transaction report CSV you download from Elite"
93:          layout="list"
94:          class="w-full"
95:        />
96:        <p class="text-xs text-muted">
97:          Uploading overlapping reports is fine: each sale is matched by its Trans ID.
98:          Only the last 4 of each card are kept.
99:        </p>
100:      </form>
101:    </template>
102:    <template #footer>
103:      <div class="flex w-full justify-end gap-2">
104:        <UButton
105:          variant="outline"
106:          :label="result ? 'Done' : 'Cancel'"
107:          @click="open = false"
108:        />
109:        <UButton
110:          v-if="!result"
111:          type="submit"
112:          form="elite-import-form"
113:          color="primary"
114:          icon="i-lucide-upload"
115:          label="Import"
116:          :loading="running"
117:          :disabled="!file"
118:        />
119:      </div>
120:    </template>
121:  </UModal>
122:</template>

1:<script setup lang="ts">
2:/*
3: * Stats: card sales (Elite reports), expenses, profit, and website visits and
4: * Google search numbers, for a date range in shop time. Owners and admins only
5: * (adminSections); the tables and stats_summary() enforce the same.
6: *
7: * Profit here is card sales minus refunds minus the expenses entered. Website
8: * orders are shown on their own: they're paid by card too, so adding them to
9: * the card total would count them twice.
10: */
11:import type { TableColumn } from '@nuxt/ui'
12:import type { Tables } from '~~/shared/types/database.types'
13:
14:definePageMeta({ layout: 'admin', middleware: 'admin' })
15:useSeoMeta({ title: 'Stats' })
16:
17:type Tab = 'overview' | 'sales' | 'expenses' | 'website' | 'connections'
18:type CardSale = Tables<'card_transactions'>
19:type Expense = Tables<'expenses'>
20:type CardImport = Tables<'card_imports'>
21:
22:const { supabase, check, notifyError } = useAdmin()
23:const route = useRoute()
24:const router = useRouter()
25:
26:const tabs = [
27:  { label: 'Overview', value: 'overview', icon: 'i-lucide-chart-no-axes-combined' },
28:  { label: 'Card sales', value: 'sales', icon: 'i-lucide-credit-card' },
29:  { label: 'Expenses', value: 'expenses', icon: 'i-lucide-wallet' },
30:  { label: 'Website', value: 'website', icon: 'i-lucide-globe' },
31:  { label: 'Connections', value: 'connections', icon: 'i-lucide-plug' },
32:] satisfies { label: string, value: Tab, icon: string }[]
33:const tab = computed<Tab>({
34:  get: () => (tabs.some(t => t.value === route.query.tab) ? route.query.tab as Tab : 'overview'),
35:  set: value => router.replace({ query: { ...route.query, tab: value === 'overview' ? undefined : value } }),
36:})
37:
38:/* ---- Date range (shop time) ---------------------------------------------- */
39:const isoDay = (d: Date) => zonedDate(d, shopTimeZone)
40:const shiftDay = (day: string, n: number) => {
41:  const d = new Date(`${day}T12:00:00Z`)
42:  d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + n)
43:  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
44:}
45:const ranges = [
46:  { label: 'Last 7 days', value: '7' },
47:  { label: 'Last 30 days', value: '30' },
48:  { label: 'Last 90 days', value: '90' },
49:  { label: 'This month', value: 'month' },
50:  { label: 'Last month', value: 'last-month' },
51:  { label: 'This year', value: 'year' },
52:  { label: 'Last 12 months', value: '365' },
53:]
54:const range = ref('30')
55:const period = computed(() => {
56:  const today = isoDay(new Date())
57:  const [y, m] = today.split('-').map(Number) as [number, number]
58:  switch (range.value) {
59:    case 'month': return { from: `${today.slice(0, 7)}-01`, to: today }
60:    case 'last-month': {
61:      const first = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 2, 1)).toISOString().slice(0, 10)
62:      return { from: first, to: shiftDay(`${today.slice(0, 7)}-01`, -1) }
63:    }
64:    case 'year': return { from: `${y}-01-01`, to: today }
65:    default: return { from: shiftDay(today, -(Number(range.value) - 1)), to: today }
66:  }
67:})
68:const lo = computed(() => zonedInstant(period.value.from, '00:00', shopTimeZone).toISOString())
69:const hi = computed(() => zonedInstant(shiftDay(period.value.to, 1), '00:00', shopTimeZone).toISOString())
70:
71:/* ---- Data ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
72:const summary = ref<StatsSummary | null>(null)
73:const sales = ref<CardSale[]>([])
74:const expenses = ref<Expense[]>([])
75:const imports = ref<CardImport[]>([])
76:const search = ref<SearchReport | null>(null)
77:const loading = ref(true)
78:
79:async function loadSummary() {
80:  const { data } = check(await supabase.rpc('stats_summary', { from_day: period.value.from, to_day: period.value.to }))
81:  summary.value = data as unknown as StatsSummary
82:}
83:async function loadSales() {
84:  const { data } = check(await supabase.from('card_transactions').select('*')
85:    .gte('occurred_at', lo.value).lt('occurred_at', hi.value).order('occurred_at', { ascending: false }).limit(1000))
86:  sales.value = data
87:  const history = check(await supabase.from('card_imports').select('*').order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(5))
88:  imports.value = history.data
89:}
90:async function loadExpenses() {
91:  const { data } = check(await supabase.from('expenses').select('*')
92:    .gte('spent_on', period.value.from).lte('spent_on', period.value.to).order('spent_on', { ascending: false }).limit(1000))
93:  expenses.value = data
94:}
95:async function loadSearch() {
96:  search.value = null
97:  try {
98:    search.value = await $fetch<SearchReport>('/api/admin/stats/search', { query: period.value })
99:  }
100:  catch (err) {
101:    search.value = { status: 'error', error: useAdmin().errorMessage(err) }
102:  }
103:}
104:
105:async function load() {
106:  loading.value = true
107:  try {
108:    await Promise.all([loadSummary(), loadSales(), loadExpenses()])
109:  }
110:  catch (err) {
111:    notifyError(err, 'Couldn\'t load stats')
112:  }
113:  finally {
114:    loading.value = false
115:  }
116:  loadSearch()
117:}
118:watch(period, load)
119:onMounted(load)
120:
121:/* ---- Numbers ------------------------------------------------------------- */
122:const money = (v: number) => v.toLocaleString('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' })
123:const count = (v: number) => v.toLocaleString('en-US')
124:const s = computed(() => summary.value)
125:const netSales = computed(() => (s.value ? s.value.sales.gross - s.value.sales.refunds : 0))
126:const profit = computed(() => netSales.value - (s.value?.expenses.total ?? 0))
127:const margin = computed(() => (netSales.value > 0 ? `${Math.round((profit.value / netSales.value) * 100)}% of sales` : undefined))
128:const avgSale = computed(() => (s.value?.sales.count ? s.value.sales.gross / s.value.sales.count : 0))
129:const declineRate = computed(() => {
130:  const total = (s.value?.sales.count ?? 0) + (s.value?.sales.declined ?? 0)
131:  return total ? `${Math.round(((s.value?.sales.declined ?? 0) / total) * 100)}% of attempts` : undefined
132:})
133:const conversion = computed(() => (s.value?.visits.visitors && s.value.orders.count
134:  ? `${((s.value.orders.count / s.value.visits.visitors) * 100).toFixed(1)}% of visitors`
135:  : undefined))
136:
137:const salesDays = computed(() => (s.value?.daily ?? []).map(d => ({ day: d.day, value: d.sales, second: d.expenses })))
138:const visitDays = computed(() => (s.value?.daily ?? []).map(d => ({ day: d.day, value: d.views, second: d.visitors })))
139:const buckets = (items: StatsBucket[] | undefined, by: 'total' | 'count') =>
140:  (items ?? []).map(b => ({ label: b.label || 'Unknown', value: b[by] ?? 0, detail: by === 'total' && b.count !== undefined ? `${b.count}` : undefined }))
141:
142:const weekdays = ['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat']
143:const byWeekday = computed(() => weekdays.map((label, dow) => ({
144:  label, value: s.value?.sales.byWeekday.find(w => w.dow === dow)?.total ?? 0,
145:})))
146:const busiestHours = computed(() => [...(s.value?.sales.byHour ?? [])]
147:  .sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total).slice(0, 5)
148:  .map(h => ({ label: `${(h.hour % 12) || 12}${h.hour < 12 ? 'am' : 'pm'}–${((h.hour + 1) % 12) || 12}${h.hour + 1 < 12 || h.hour + 1 === 24 ? 'am' : 'pm'}`, value: h.total, detail: `${h.count}` })))
149:
150:/* ---- Card sales tab ------------------------------------------------------ */
151:const importOpen = ref(false)
152:const salesSearch = ref('')
153:const salesStatus = ref<'all' | 'Settled' | 'Declined'>('all')
154:const filteredSales = computed(() => {
155:  const q = salesSearch.value.trim().toLowerCase()
156:  return sales.value.filter(t => (salesStatus.value === 'all' || t.status === salesStatus.value)
157:    && (!q || [t.cardholder, t.customer, t.trans_id, t.last4, t.card_type, t.auth_code].some(v => v.toLowerCase().includes(q))))
158:})
159:const salesColumns: TableColumn<CardSale>[] = [
160:  { accessorKey: 'occurred_at', header: 'When' },
161:  { accessorKey: 'cardholder', header: 'Cardholder' },
162:  { accessorKey: 'card_type', header: 'Card' },
163:  { accessorKey: 'total', header: 'Total' },
164:  { accessorKey: 'status', header: 'Status' },
165:]
166:const statusColor = (status: string) => (status === 'Settled' ? 'success' : status === 'Declined' ? 'error' : 'neutral')
167:
168:/* ---- Expenses tab -------------------------------------------------------- */
169:const expenseOpen = ref(false)
170:const editingExpense = ref<Expense | null>(null)
171:function editExpense(expense: Expense | null) {
172:  editingExpense.value = expense
173:  expenseOpen.value = true
174:}
175:const usedCategories = computed(() => [...new Set(expenses.value.map(e => e.category))])
176:const expenseColumns: TableColumn<Expense>[] = [
177:  { accessorKey: 'spent_on', header: 'Date' },
178:  { accessorKey: 'category', header: 'Category' },
179:  { accessorKey: 'description', header: 'Note' },
180:  { accessorKey: 'amount', header: 'Amount' },
181:]
182:async function expensesChanged() {
183:  try {
184:    await Promise.all([loadExpenses(), loadSummary()])
185:  }
186:  catch (err) {
187:    notifyError(err, 'Couldn\'t reload stats')
188:  }
189:}
190:
191:const dayLabel = (day: string) => new Date(`${day}T12:00`).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })
192:const searchReady = computed(() => (search.value?.status === 'ok' ? search.value : null))

<script setup lang="ts">
/*
 * A daily bar chart for Stats: one bar per day, optional second series drawn
 * as a thinner bar in front (expenses against sales, visitors against views).
 * Plain SVG sized by CSS, so it needs no chart library.
 */
const props = defineProps<{
  days: { day: string, value: number, second?: number }[]
  format: (value: number) => string
  label: string
  secondLabel?: string
}>()

const max = computed(() => Math.max(1, ...props.days.flatMap(d => [d.value, d.second ?? 0])))
const hovered = ref<number | null>(null)
const shown = computed(() => (hovered.value === null ? null : props.days[hovered.value]))
const total = computed(() => props.days.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.value, 0))
const dayLabel = (day: string) => new Date(`${day}T12:00`).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })
// Label a handful of days along the bottom, not all of them.
const tickEvery = computed(() => Math.max(1, Math.ceil(props.days.length / 7)))
</script>

<template>
  <div class="grid gap-2">
    <div class="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-x-4 text-sm">
      <span class="text-muted">
        <template v-if="shown">
          {{ dayLabel(shown.day) }}:
          <span class="font-medium text-highlighted">{{ format(shown.value) }}</span> {{ label.toLowerCase() }}
          <template v-if="secondLabel">
            · <span class="font-medium text-highlighted">{{ format(shown.second ?? 0) }}</span> {{ secondLabel.toLowerCase() }}
          </template>
        </template>
        <template v-else>
          Hover a day for details
        </template>
      </span>
      <span class="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-muted">
        <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><span class="size-2.5 rounded-sm bg-primary" />{{ label }}</span>
        <span
          v-if="secondLabel"
          class="flex items-center gap-1.5"
        ><span class="size-2.5 rounded-sm bg-inverted/60" />{{ secondLabel }}</span>
      </span>
    </div>
    <div
      class="chart"
      role="img"
      :aria-label="`${label} per day, ${format(total)} in total`"
      @mouseleave="hovered = null"
    >
      <div
        v-for="(d, i) in days"
        :key="d.day"
        class="day"
        :class="{ dim: hovered !== null && hovered !== i }"
        @mouseenter="hovered = i"
      >
        <div
          class="bar bg-primary"
          :style="{ height: `${(d.value / max) * 100}%` }"
        />
        <div
          v-if="secondLabel"
          class="bar second bg-inverted/60"
          :style="{ height: `${((d.second ?? 0) / max) * 100}%` }"
        />
        <span
          v-if="i % tickEvery === 0"
          class="tick text-muted"
        >{{ dayLabel(d.day) }}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
